checklist: Your one-time account on rrbapply.gov.in — the form needs it before anything else
Signature scan ready: JPG, 30-49 KB, at least 140 x 60 px, running handwriting
Aadhaar and Class 10 certificate side by side — the name and date of birth must match 100%
For the live photo: a plain, light-coloured wall and light falling on your face
Copies of the final files, kept safe with your application number
documents: Signature — JPG, 30-49 KB, minimum 140 x 60 px
Passport-style photo, 35 x 45 mm, JPG, roughly 20-50 KB — standby only, if your category offers an upload option; the form itself captures the photo live
donts: No cap or sunglasses for the live photo
Do not reuse a bank or SSC signature file — their 10-20 KB band fails here
Do not sign in BLOCK CAPITAL letters
Do not let the signature slip below 30 KB — it is rejected just as firmly
Do not depend on an old studio photo file — the 2026 form captures the photo live
dos: Sit facing a plain, light-coloured wall, with the light on your face — not behind you
Keep the camera at eye level so your full face is visible and sharp
Sign in running handwriting with a black or blue pen on plain white paper
Photograph just the signature, cropped tight
Aim for about 40 KB — the middle of the 30-49 KB band
eligibility: Graduation in any stream — this CEN is for graduate-level NTPC posts.

Four graduate posts, 3,548 in all (provisional): Goods Train Manager 2,750 (Pay Level 5), Senior Clerk cum Typist 371 (Level 5), Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist 300 (Level 5) and Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor 127 (Level 6).
Age 18-33 years as on 1 January 2027 (relaxation for reserved categories as per the notice).

extra_faq.a: No. The Railway band for NTPC is 30-49 KB — a file below 30 KB is rejected too. Compress or re-scan to a target of about 40 KB, the safe middle of the band.
extra_faq.q: My signature file is only 20 KB. Will it be accepted?

extra_faq.a: Graduates apply under CEN 06/2026 (last date 8 November 2026, extended by Corrigendum-1). If you are 12th (10+2) pass, your CEN is 07/2026 (last date 13 November 2026).
extra_faq.q: Which NTPC CEN should I apply to — 06/2026 or 07/2026?

extra_faq.a: Yes. Sign in the same running-hand style you will use in the exam hall — a mismatch can cause trouble at document verification.
extra_faq.q: Should the signature match the one I use in the exam hall?

fees: Application fee: ₹500 for most candidates — ₹400 of it is refunded (less bank charges) when you appear in CBT 1.
₹250 for SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, PwBD, Female, Transgender, Minorities and EBC candidates — refunded in full (less bank charges) when you appear in CBT 1.
Correction window: 9-18 November 2026 — each change costs a non-refundable ₹250.

checklist: rrbapply.gov.in पर आपका one-time account — फॉर्म से पहले यही चाहिए
हस्ताक्षर का scan तैयार: JPG, 30-49 KB, कम से कम 140 x 60 px, चलती लिखावट
Aadhaar और Class 10 certificate साथ रखो — नाम और जन्मतिथि 100% मिलने चाहिए
Live फोटो के लिए: सादी, हल्के रंग की दीवार और चेहरे पर पड़ती रोशनी
तैयार फाइलों की copy, अपनी application संख्या के साथ संभाल कर रखो
documents: हस्ताक्षर — JPG, 30-49 KB, कम से कम 140 x 60 px
Passport-style फोटो, 35 x 45 mm, JPG, करीब 20-50 KB — सिर्फ standby, अगर आपकी category में upload का विकल्प मिले; फॉर्म खुद फोटो live लेता है
donts: Live फोटो के लिए टोपी या धूप का चश्मा नहीं

BLOCK CAPITAL अक्षरों में हस्ताक्षर मत करो
हस्ताक्षर 30 KB से नीचे न जाने दो — वह भी उतनी ही पक्की तरह reject होता है
पुरानी studio फोटो फाइल के भरोसे मत रहो — 2026 के फॉर्म में फोटो live लिया जाता है
dos: सादी, हल्के रंग की दीवार के सामने बैठो, रोशनी चेहरे पर पड़े — पीछे से नहीं
कैमरा आंखों के बराबर रखो ताकि पूरा चेहरा साफ़ और तेज़ दिखे
सादे सफेद कागज़ पर काले या नीले पेन से चलती लिखावट में हस्ताक्षर करो
सिर्फ हस्ताक्षर की फोटो लो, आसपास की जगह काटकर
करीब 40 KB का target रखो — 30-49 KB band के ठीक बीच में
eligibility: किसी भी stream में graduation — यह CEN स्नातक-स्तर के NTPC पदों के लिए है।

चार स्नातक पद, कुल 3,548 (provisional): Goods Train Manager 2,750 (Pay Level 5), Senior Clerk cum Typist 371 (Level 5), Junior Accounts Assistant cum Typist 300 (Level 5) और Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor 127 (Level 6)।
उम्र 1 जनवरी 2027 को 18-33 वर्ष (आरक्षित श्रेणियों को notice के अनुसार छूट)।

extra_faq.a: स्नातक CEN 06/2026 में आवेदन करें (अंतिम तिथि 8 नवंबर 2026, Corrigendum-1 से बढ़ाई गई)। अगर आप 12वीं (10+2) पास हैं तो आपका CEN 07/2026 है (अंतिम तिथि 13 नवंबर 2026)।
extra_faq.q: किस NTPC CEN में आवेदन करूँ — 06/2026 या 07/2026?

kit.title: हस्ताक्षर — target 40 KB रखो

kit.text: अगर आपकी category में फोटो upload का option मिले तो passport-style फोटो यहाँ resize करो। मुख्य फॉर्म में live camera फोटो ही लगता है।
kit.title: फोटो resize (standby)

kit.title: Document PDF — छोटा करो

Photo ready in the 50-200 KB band — JPEG, white background

Caste/reservation certificates in the prescribed forms, with the RD number

donts: Do not submit a photo or signature outside the KB band — non-conforming uploads are rejected
Do not wait for the last day — the form closes 25 November 2026 and there is no correction at any stage
Do not apply expecting to fix a wrong category later — only the reservation claimed in the application counts
Do not leave a question with no circle shaded in the OMR expecting no penalty — an unshaded question also loses 0.25
dos: Aim for about 100 KB for the photo and about 60 KB for the signature — safely inside both bands
Sign with a black sketch or marker pen on plain white paper, and crop the scan to the signature area

eligibility: 5,431 posts in all: FDA 2,726 (RPC 2,163 + Kalyana-Karnataka 563) and SDA 2,705 (RPC 2,070 + Kalyana-Karnataka 635), plus allied posts like Accounts Assistant, Warden, Hostel Supervisor and computer-operator posts.

FDA posts need a Bachelor's degree; SDA posts need 2nd PUC (12th pass) or a diploma, post-wise. The qualification must be held on or before 25 November 2026 — candidates awaiting results are not eligible.

Age (as on 25 November 2026): minimum 18; maximum 40 for General Merit, 43 for Cat-2A/2B/3A/3B, 45 for SC/ST/Cat-1 — these maximums already include a one-time 5-year relaxation. PwD candidates, widows and ex-servicemen get further relaxation as per the notice.
A compulsory Kannada Language Test (150 marks, minimum 50 to pass) applies unless you are exempt — for example, if you studied Kannada as a first or second language up to SSLC or higher.

Selection: offline OMR competitive exam — Paper-1 General Knowledge (100 marks) and Paper-2 General Kannada, General English & Computer Knowledge (100 marks); a minimum of 35% is compulsory; −0.25 for every wrong answer, and also for a question left with no circle shaded.

extra_faq.a: No. The notification is explicit — once the application is submitted, no information can be changed or corrected at any stage, and correction requests are not entertained. Check everything twice before you submit.
extra_faq.q: Can I correct the form after submitting?

extra_faq.a: A compulsory qualifying test of 150 marks — you must score at least 50. Its marks are not counted in the merit list, but failing it makes you ineligible. Candidates who studied Kannada as a first or second language up to SSLC or higher, studied in Kannada medium, or have passed the test before, are exempt.
extra_faq.q: What is the Kannada Language Test?

extra_faq.a: ₹750 for General Merit and Cat-2A/2B/3A/3B, ₹500 for SC/ST/Cat-1/Ex-servicemen/Transgender and ₹250 for PwD candidates, paid online by 26 November 2026. The fee is not refunded.

उम्र (25 नवंबर 2026 को): न्यूनतम 18; अधिकतम — General Merit 40, Cat-2A/2B/3A/3B 43, SC/ST/Cat-1 45 — इन अधिकतम सीमाओं में एक बार की 5 वर्ष की छूट पहले से शामिल है। PwD, विधवाओं और भूतपूर्व सैनिकों को notice के अनुसार अतिरिक्त छूट मिलती है।

eligibility: 2,423 posts in 15 subjects (post codes 26046–26060): English 187, Mathematics 281, Hindi 187, Political Science 156, History 156, Economics 156, plus Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Sanskrit, Computer, Music, Commerce, Physical Education and Fine Arts. The total is the sum of the subject-wise figures in the notice and is tentative.

Most subjects need a Master's degree in the subject (50%) with B.Ed (50%) and TET passed; English and Mathematics follow their own pattern (55% in the subject at graduation). All qualifications must be held by 5 December 2026.

fees: Examination fee ₹100 + processing fee ₹700 = ₹800 for every candidate — there is no category exemption.

eligibility: 501 vacancies (495 General + 6 Special recruitment): Review Officer 131 and RO (Account) 31, Assistant Review Officer 329 and ARO (Account) 6, plus Manager, Care-Taker, Receptionist (Swagati) and Store Keeper (1 each, in UPPSC).

RO/ARO (Secretariat, Board of Revenue, Advocate General offices): Bachelor's degree, an 'O' Level certificate (DOEACC/NIELIT) or equivalent, and Hindi typing of at least 25 wpm — English typing is preferred. UPPSC-office RO/ARO posts also accept a Computer Science diploma in place of 'O' Level; accountant posts need B.Com with Accountancy and 'O' Level in Computer Application.
One Time Registration (OTR) on otr.pariksha.nic.in is compulsory, and it must be at least 72 hours old before you start the application.
Age: 21–40 years as on 1 July 2026 (born 2 July 1986 to 1 July 2005), with the relaxations printed in the notice. Date of birth is accepted only as recorded in the High School certificate.

Selection: Prelims (General Studies 140 + General Hindi 60 = 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours, negative marking of one-third) and then the Mains (four written papers of 200 marks each). There is no interview; merit is on the Mains alone. The minimum efficiency standard is 40% (35% for SC/ST of UP) in both stages.

उम्र: 1 जुलाई 2026 को 21–40 वर्ष (जन्म 2 जुलाई 1986 से 1 जुलाई 2005), notice में छपी छूटों के साथ। जन्म तिथि सिर्फ़ हाई स्कूल प्रमाणपत्र में दर्ज तिथि ही मानी जाती है।

चयन: प्रारंभिक परीक्षा (सामान्य अध्ययन 140 + सामान्य हिंदी 60 = 200 सवाल, 200 अंक, 3 घंटे, एक-तिहाई negative marking) और फिर मुख्य परीक्षा (चार लिखित पेपर, हर एक 200 अंक)। कोई साक्षात्कार नहीं; merit सिर्फ़ मुख्य परीक्षा पर। न्यूनतम दक्षता मानक दोनों चरणों में 40% (यूपी के SC/ST के लिए 35%) है।

extra_faq.a: otr.pariksha.nic.in पर One Time Registration से सभी UPPSC परीक्षाओं के लिए एक स्थायी रजिस्ट्रेशन number मिलता है। विज्ञापन के अनुसार OTR number आवेदन शुरू करने से कम से कम 72 घंटे पहले प्राप्त होना चाहिए — उसके बिना आवेदन पूरा नहीं हो सकता। तुम्हारी फोटो और हस्ताक्षर भी OTR प्रोफ़ाइल से ही लिए जाते हैं।
extra_faq.q: OTR क्या है, और 72 घंटे का नियम क्यों?

extra_faq.a: हाँ — correction/संशोधन और शुल्क मिलान 3 दिसंबर 2026 तक खुले हैं। शैक्षणिक योग्यता में संशोधन Candidate Dashboard से सिर्फ़ एक बार हो सकता है, और OTR व्यक्तिगत details के बदलाव वहाँ synchronise करने होते हैं।
extra_faq.q: क्या आवेदन सुधारा जा सकता है?

extra_faq.a: विज्ञापन में सभी पदों के लिए मिलाकर सिर्फ़ समग्र सीमा छपी है — Pay Level-5 (₹29,200–64,700) से Pay Level-8 (₹47,600–1,51,100) तक। RO बनाम ARO का अलग break-up नहीं छपा है।
extra_faq.q: RO/ARO का वेतन कितना है?

fees: प्रारंभिक परीक्षा शुल्क (परीक्षा शुल्क + ₹25 online processing शुल्क): UR / EWS / OBC ₹125; SC / ST ₹65; PwD ₹25; भूतपूर्व सैनिक ₹65। स्वतंत्रता सेनानी आश्रित, महिलाएँ और कुशल खिलाड़ी अपनी मूल श्रेणी के अनुसार शुल्क भरते हैं।
मुख्य परीक्षा के लिए अर्हता पाने वाले उम्मीदवार दूसरा, अलग शुल्क भरते हैं — UR/EWS/OBC ₹225, यूपी के SC/ST ₹105, PwD ₹25। भुगतान SBI MOPS से होता है।

en.tagline: 3,047 apprentice seats across 24 work centres — apply free on the NAPS/NATS portal by 20 November 2026.
fees: No application fee is mentioned in the advertisement — applications are made only through the NAPS portal (ITI/trade seats) or the NATS portal (diploma/graduate seats).
eligibility: Age 18–24 years as on 29 November 2026 (born between 29 November 2002 and 29 November 2008). Relaxation: SC/ST +5 years, OBC (NCL) +3 years, PwBD +10 to 15 years as per rules.

Qualification is trade-wise: 10th pass for trades like Library Assistant; ITI in the relevant trade for COPA, Electrician, Fitter and similar trades; 12th or ITI for Fire Safety Technician; B.Sc (Chemistry) for Lab Chemist; BBA for Executive (HR); any graduate for Secretarial Assistant; a 3-year Diploma or Degree for the diploma/graduate executive trades; a Geology degree for Petroleum Executive.
You must not have completed 3 years since passing the qualifying examination, and the district-of-residence rules in the advertisement decide which work centre you can choose.
Selection is on the merit of qualifying-examination marks, followed by document verification — there is no written test. The advertisement gives 15 December 2026 as the result/selection date.
Stipend during the 12-month training: Graduate apprentice ₹12,300/month, 3-year Diploma ₹10,900, 2-year ITI ₹10,560, 1-year ITI ₹9,600, Trade apprentice (10th/12th) ₹8,200.
specs: The advertisement does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for on the upload screen.
Keep a recent colour photograph and a clear signature scan (signed on white paper) ready before you start.
Upload only clear, readable scans; a blurred photo or signature can get the form rejected.
dos: Register on the correct portal — NAPS for ITI/trade seats, NATS for diploma/graduate seats.
Choose the trade and work centre your district and qualification actually allow.
Keep your NAPS/NATS registration number safe; it is needed throughout.
Apply well before 20 November — there is no fee window or correction window after it.
Keep the qualifying-exam marksheet ready; selection is purely on its marks.
donts: Do not treat this as a permanent ONGC job — it is 12-month apprenticeship training.
Do not pay anyone for this application — the advertisement charges no fee.
Do not apply if 3 years have already passed since your qualifying exam.
Do not apply for a trade your qualification does not match.
Do not wait for a correction window — the advertisement announces none.

en.fees_short: Online — CG residents refunded if they appear
fees: The application fee is charged online by category on the CGSSB portal while you apply.
Special rule of this board: the exam fee is refunded to Chhattisgarh local-resident candidates who actually appear in the written examination.
eligibility: Posts: Assistant Grade-3 — 1,206; ASI (District Unit Cadre) — 279; Registrar Clerk — 50; ASI (General Branch) — 40; SI-A Stenographer — 34; Stenographer (Hindi) — 30; Data Entry Operator — 25; Steno-Typist — 23; Stenographer (Bilingual) — 13; Stenographer (English) — 3.

Qualification and age are post-wise — these are Graduate and Post-Graduate level Class-III posts, and the detailed advertisement's eligibility table on the portal is final. Check your post's row carefully before paying the fee.
Selection is through a single written examination on 10 January 2027 (10:00 AM–12:15 PM) at the five divisional headquarters. Admit cards are expected around 4 January 2027.
A correction window runs from 28 to 30 November 2026 for mistakes in the submitted form.
specs: The advertisement does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for on the upload screen.
Keep a recent colour photograph and a clear signature scan (signed on white paper) ready before you start.
Upload only clear, readable scans; a blurred photo or signature can get the form rejected.
dos: Read the post-wise eligibility table in the detailed advertisement before choosing a post.
Apply by 27 November 2026 (5:00 PM) — the window is short.
Use the correction window (28–30 November) for any genuine mistake.
CG local residents: keep your domicile certificate ready — the fee refund and reservation both depend on it.
Note your exam centre division; the exam is held only at the five divisional headquarters.
donts: Do not assume every post needs the same qualification — eligibility is post-wise.
Do not skip appearing in the exam if you want the fee refund — it is paid only to those who actually appear.
Do not apply on any site other than the official CGSSB portal.
Do not wait for the correction window to fix a wrong post choice if the notice treats it as final — read the correction rules first.
Do not upload a blurred photo or signature.
checklist: Degree / PG marksheets and certificates scanned (as your post requires)
Chhattisgarh domicile certificate scanned, if applicable
Caste certificate scanned, if applicable
10th certificate (age proof) scanned
Photo and signature scans ready
Application fee payment method ready
documents: Degree/PG marksheets and certificate for the post applied
Chhattisgarh domicile certificate (for reservation and fee refund)

kit.title: Keep a passport photo ready
kit.text: Scan a recent colour photo on a light background; shrink an oversized file here first.

kit.title: Clean signature scan
kit.text: Sign on white paper and scan it clearly — a blurred signature can be rejected.

kit.title: Join certificates into one PDF
kit.text: Merge all documents into one clean PDF, ready for upload.

mistakes: Choosing a post without reading its own qualification row in the eligibility table.
Missing the 5:00 PM close on 27 November — the window ends earlier in the day than most portals.
Forgetting that the fee refund applies only to CG local residents who actually sit the exam.
Letting the 28–30 November correction window pass with a wrong detail still in the form.
steps: Open cgssb.cgstate.gov.in and read the detailed advertisement for Exam G20227.
Register and fill the application for your post before 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM.
Upload photo, signature and documents, and pay the fee online by category.
Use the correction window from 28 to 30 November 2026 if anything is wrong.
Download the admit card around 4 January 2027 and appear in the written exam on 10 January 2027.

extra_faq.q: Is the CGSSB fee really refunded?
extra_faq.a: As per the board's rule, the exam fee is refunded to Chhattisgarh local-resident candidates who actually appear in the written examination. Candidates who stay absent do not get the refund.

extra_faq.q: Can I correct my CGSSB form?
extra_faq.a: Yes — a correction window is open from 28 to 30 November 2026, right after applications close on 27 November. Check the notice for which fields can be corrected.

hi.name: CGSSB Group-2 (Class-III Posts)
hi.tagline: 1,703 Group-2 Class-III pad — Assistant Grade-3, ASI, Data Entry Operator, Stenographer aur anya — likhit pariksha 10 January 2027 ko.
hi.fees_short: Online — CG niwasiyon ko pariksha dene par refund
fees: Application fee apply karte samay CGSSB portal par varg ke hisaab se online lagti hai.
Is board ka khaas niyam: Chhattisgarh ke sthaniya niwasi ummeedwar jo asal me likhit pariksha me baithte hain, unhe pariksha shulk wapas milta hai.
eligibility: Pad: Assistant Grade-3 — 1,206; ASI (District Unit Cadre) — 279; Registrar Clerk — 50; ASI (General Branch) — 40; SI-A Stenographer — 34; Stenographer (Hindi) — 30; Data Entry Operator — 25; Steno-Typist — 23; Stenographer (Bilingual) — 13; Stenographer (English) — 3.

Yogyata aur aayu post ke hisaab se hai — ye Graduate aur Post-Graduate star ke Class-III pad hain, aur portal par detailed advertisement ki eligibility table hi antim hai. Fee dene se pehle apne post ki row dhyaan se dekho.
Chayan ek hi likhit pariksha se hoga — 10 January 2027 (subah 10:00–12:15) ko paanchon sambhagiya mukhyalayon par. Admit card 4 January 2027 ke aas-paas aane ki ummeed hai.
Submitted form ki galtiyon ke liye 28 se 30 November 2026 tak correction window rahegi.
specs: Vigyapan me photo aur signature ke liye koi pakki KB size nahi di gayi hai — portal ki upload screen par jo format aur size manga jaye, usi me upload karo.
Form shuru karne se pehle nayi colour photograph aur safed kagaz par kiya saaf signature scan ready rakho.
Sirf saaf, padhi ja sakne wali scans upload karo; dhundli photo ya signature par form reject ho sakta hai.
dos: Post chunne se pehle detailed advertisement me post-wise eligibility table padho.
27 November 2026 (shaam 5:00 baje) tak apply karo — window chhoti hai.
Koi asal galti ho to correction window (28–30 November) ka upyog karo.
CG sthaniya niwasi: domicile certificate ready rakho — fee refund aur aarakshan dono isi par nirbhar hain.
Apna pariksha kendra sambhag note karo; pariksha sirf paanch sambhagiya mukhyalayon par hogi.
donts: Ye mat samjho ki har post ki yogyata ek jaisi hai — yogyata post ke hisaab se hai.
Fee refund chahiye to pariksha me baithna mat chhodo — refund sirf unhi ko milta hai jo asal me baithte hain.
Aadhikarik CGSSB portal ke alawa kisi site par apply mat karo.
Galat post chunne par correction ka intezaar tab tak mat karo jab tak notice ke correction niyam na padh lo.
Dhundli photo ya signature upload mat karo.
checklist: Degree / PG marksheets aur certificates scan kiye hue (post ki mang ke anusar)
Chhattisgarh domicile certificate scan kiya hua, yadi lagu ho
Jaati praman patra scan kiya hua, yadi lagu ho
10th certificate (aayu ka saboot) scan kiya hua
Photo aur signature scans ready
Application fee dene ka sadhan ready
documents: Apply kiye gaye post ke liye Degree/PG marksheets aur certificate
Chhattisgarh domicile certificate (aarakshan aur fee refund ke liye)
Jaati praman patra, yadi lagu ho

kit.title: Passport photo ready rakho
kit.text: Nayi safed-background wali colour photo scan karke rakho; badi file ko yahin chhoti kar sakte ho.

kit.title: Signature ka saaf scan
kit.text: Safed kagaz par sign karke scan karo — dhundla signature reject ho sakta hai.

kit.title: Certificates ek PDF me jodo
kit.text: Saare documents ko ek saaf PDF me jodkar upload ke liye ready rakho.

mistakes: Eligibility table me apne post ki yogyata row padhe bina post chunna.
27 November ko shaam 5:00 baje ki bandi chook jana — window zyadatar portals se pehle band hoti hai.
Ye bhoolna ki fee refund sirf un CG sthaniya niwasiyon ko milta hai jo asal me pariksha me baithte hain.
Correction window (28–30 November) nikal jane dena jabki form me galat vivaran pada ho.
steps: cgssb.cgstate.gov.in kholo aur Exam G20227 ki detailed advertisement padho.
27 November 2026, shaam 5:00 baje se pehle apne post ke liye register karke application bharo.
Photo, signature aur documents upload karo, aur varg ke hisaab se fee online do.
Kuch galat ho to 28 se 30 November 2026 ke correction window me sudharo.
4 January 2027 ke aas-paas admit card download karo aur 10 January 2027 ko likhit pariksha do.

extra_faq.q: Kya CGSSB ki fee asal me wapas milti hai?
extra_faq.a: Board ke niyam ke anusar, Chhattisgarh ke sthaniya niwasi ummeedwar jo asal me likhit pariksha me baithte hain, unhe pariksha shulk wapas milta hai. Jo anupasthit rehte hain, unhe refund nahi milta.

extra_faq.q: Kya main apna CGSSB form sudhar sakta hoon?
extra_faq.a: Haan — application band hone (27 November) ke turant baad 28 se 30 November 2026 tak correction window khuli hai. Kaun se fields sudhar sakte hain, ye notice me dekho.

en.name: J&K Bank PO & Banking Associate
en.tagline: 1,397 fresher posts — 343 Probationary Officers and 1,054 Banking Associates for the J&K and Ladakh UTs — last date 26 November 2026.
fees: Probationary Officer: ₹1,200 (SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD: ₹1,000), plus GST.
Banking Associate: ₹800 (SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM: ₹600), plus GST.
The fee is paid online during the application and is not refunded.
eligibility: Posts: for the J&K UT — Banking Associate 1,033 and Probationary Officer 323; for the Ladakh UT — Banking Associate 21 and Probationary Officer 20. There are separate notifications for each UT and each post — apply on the notification of your own UT.
Domicile of the respective Union Territory (J&K or Ladakh) is compulsory. After selection, a minimum of 5 years' service in the allotted zone applies.
Education: graduation in any discipline from a recognised university.
Age 20–30 years as on 1 January 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST +5 years, SEBC +3 years in J&K (+5 years in Ladakh), PwBD +10 years.

Selection is conducted through IBPS. Banking Associate: a single online exam of 100 questions / 100 marks in 60 minutes, with −0.25 per wrong answer. Probationary Officer: Prelims, then Mains (170 questions / 200 marks plus a 25-mark descriptive paper), then an Interview of 100 marks — final merit is Mains 80 : Interview 20.

Pay: PO starts at a basic of ₹48,480 (JMGS-I scale ₹48,480–85,920); Banking Associate starts at a basic of ₹24,050 (scale ₹24,050–64,480). Probation: PO 2 years (bond ₹2 lakh), Banking Associate 6 months (bond ₹1 lakh).
specs: Photograph: recent colour photo, 4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 200 × 230 pixels, JPG, 20–50 KB.
Live photograph: a live photo is also captured during the application — fill the form yourself, in good light, so the live capture matches your uploaded photo.
Signature: sign with black ink on white paper — NOT in capital letters — and scan at 140 × 60 pixels, JPG, 10–20 KB.
Left thumb impression: on white paper, scanned at 240 × 240 pixels at 200 DPI, JPG, 20–50 KB.
Hand-written declaration: write the declaration text in your own handwriting in English (not in capitals), scan at 800 × 400 pixels at 200 DPI, JPG, 50–100 KB.
Other documents: PDF files of up to 500 KB each; scan documents at a minimum of 200 DPI.
dos: Apply on the notification of your own UT — J&K and Ladakh have separate notifications and separate post counts.
Keep all five uploads ready in exact size: photo, live photo, signature, thumb impression and hand-written declaration.
Write the declaration by hand in your own handwriting — a typed declaration is rejected.
Check your domicile certificate before applying; without UT domicile the form is not valid.
Fill the form in good light so the live photograph capture is clear.
donts: Do not sign in CAPITAL letters — such signatures are rejected.
Do not apply if you are not a domicile of J&K or Ladakh UT.
Do not upload someone else's photo or a selfie in place of the scanned photo.
Do not miss that the PO and Banking Associate have different fees and different exams.
Do not leave the form for 26 November evening — fee payment closes with the application.
checklist: Photo (200 × 230 px, 20–50 KB) ready, and good light for the live photo
Signature scan (140 × 60 px, 10–20 KB) — black ink, no capitals
Left thumb impression (240 × 240 px, 20–50 KB) ready
Hand-written declaration (800 × 400 px, 50–100 KB) written and scanned
Graduation degree and marksheets scanned (PDF, up to 500 KB each)
UT domicile certificate scanned
Caste / SEBC / PwBD certificate scanned, if applicable
documents: Domicile certificate of J&K or Ladakh UT, as applicable

kit.title: Photo file in 20–50 KB
kit.text: Size the upload photo first; a live photo is also captured while you fill the form.

kit.title: Signature, thumb and declaration
kit.text: Keep all three scans inside their pixel/KB ranges — the form stops if a file is out of range.

kit.title: Other documents as PDFs
kit.text: Keep certificates as clean PDF files under 500 KB each.

mistakes: Applying on the other UT's notification — the 1,356 J&K posts and 41 Ladakh posts are separate notifications.
Signature in capital letters, or a declaration that is typed instead of hand-written.
Forgetting the live photograph — applying from a dark room or through someone else leads to a mismatch.
Applying without a domicile certificate of the UT and getting rejected at verification.
steps: Open jkb.bank.in, go to Careers and open the PO or Banking Associate notification for your UT.
Register with your email and mobile number.
Fill the form, upload the photo and capture the live photograph in good light.
Upload the signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration in the exact pixel and KB sizes.
Pay the fee online (PO ₹1,200 / BA ₹800, less for reserved categories) and submit before 26 November 2026.
Save the registration number and the application print.

extra_faq.q: I live outside J&K and Ladakh — can I apply?
extra_faq.a: No. Domicile of the respective Union Territory is compulsory in these notifications — the J&K posts are for J&K domiciles and the Ladakh posts are for Ladakh domiciles.

extra_faq.q: Who conducts the J&K Bank exam?
extra_faq.a: The selection process is conducted through IBPS as per the bank's notifications — a single online exam for Banking Associate, and Prelims + Mains + Interview for Probationary Officer.

hi.name: J&K Bank PO & Banking Associate
hi.tagline: 1,397 fresher pad — J&K aur Ladakh UTs ke liye 343 Probationary Officer aur 1,054 Banking Associate — antim tithi 26 November 2026.
fees: Probationary Officer: ₹1,200 (SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD: ₹1,000), GST alag se.
Banking Associate: ₹800 (SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM: ₹600), GST alag se.
Fee application ke dauran online deni hai aur wapas nahi hoti.
eligibility: Pad: J&K UT ke liye — Banking Associate 1,033 aur Probationary Officer 323; Ladakh UT ke liye — Banking Associate 21 aur Probationary Officer 20. Har UT aur har post ki alag notification hai — apne UT ki notification par hi apply karo.
Sambandhit kendra shasit pradesh (J&K ya Ladakh) ka domicile anivarya hai. Chayan ke baad allotted zone me kam se kam 5 saal ki seva lagu hoti hai.
Shiksha: kisi manyata prapt vishvavidyalaya se kisi bhi vishay me graduation.
Aayu 1 January 2026 ko 20–30 saal. Chhoot: SC/ST +5 saal, SEBC J&K me +3 saal (Ladakh me +5 saal), PwBD +10 saal.

Chayan IBPS ke madhyam se hota hai. Banking Associate: ek hi online pariksha — 100 prashn / 100 ank, 60 minute, har galat jawab par −0.25. Probationary Officer: Prelims, phir Mains (170 prashn / 200 ank + 25 ank ka descriptive paper), phir 100 ank ka Interview — antim merit Mains 80 : Interview 20 ke anupaat se banti hai.

Vetan: PO ki shuruaat basic ₹48,480 se (JMGS-I scale ₹48,480–85,920); Banking Associate ki shuruaat basic ₹24,050 se (scale ₹24,050–64,480). Probation: PO 2 saal (bond ₹2 lakh), Banking Associate 6 mahine (bond ₹1 lakh).
specs: Photograph: nayi colour photo, 4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 200 × 230 pixels, JPG, 20–50 KB.
Live photograph: application ke dauran live photo bhi li jati hai — form khud bharo aur achhi roshni me bharo, taaki live capture upload photo se match kare.
Signature: safed kagaz par kali syahi se sign karo — CAPITAL aksharon me NAHI — aur 140 × 60 pixels, JPG, 10–20 KB me scan karo.
Bayein angoothe ka nishan: safed kagaz par, 240 × 240 pixels 200 DPI par scan, JPG, 20–50 KB.
Hand-written declaration: declaration ka text apni handwriting me English me likho (capital me nahi), 800 × 400 pixels 200 DPI par scan karo, JPG, 50–100 KB.
Baaki documents: har ek 500 KB tak ki PDF files; documents kam se kam 200 DPI par scan karo.
dos: Apne UT ki notification par apply karo — J&K aur Ladakh ki notifications aur post counts alag hain.
Paanchon uploads exact size me ready rakho: photo, live photo, signature, angoothe ka nishan aur hand-written declaration.
Declaration apne haath se likho — typed declaration reject hoti hai.
Apply se pehle domicile certificate check karo; UT domicile ke bina form valid nahi hai.
Form achhi roshni me bharo taaki live photograph saaf aaye.
donts: CAPITAL aksharon me sign mat karo — aise signature reject hote hain.
J&K ya Ladakh UT ke domicile na ho to apply mat karo.
Scan ki hui photo ki jagah kisi aur ki photo ya selfie upload mat karo.
Ye mat bhoolo ki PO aur Banking Associate ki fee aur pariksha alag-alag hain.
Form 26 November ki shaam tak mat chhodo — fee payment application ke saath hi band hota hai.
checklist: Photo (200 × 230 px, 20–50 KB) ready, aur live photo ke liye achhi roshni
Signature scan (140 × 60 px, 10–20 KB) — kali syahi, capital nahi
Bayein angoothe ka nishan (240 × 240 px, 20–50 KB) ready
Hand-written declaration (800 × 400 px, 50–100 KB) likhkar scan ki hui
Graduation degree aur marksheets scan ki hui (PDF, har ek 500 KB tak)
UT domicile certificate scan kiya hua
Jaati / SEBC / PwBD certificate scan kiya hua, yadi lagu ho
documents: Lagu hisaab se J&K ya Ladakh UT ka domicile certificate
Varg praman patra (SC/ST/SEBC/PwBD/ESM), yadi lagu ho

kit.title: Photo file 20–50 KB me
kit.text: Upload wali photo ko pehle sahi size me kar lo; form ke samay live photo bhi li jayegi.

kit.title: Signature, thumb aur declaration
kit.text: Teeno scans ko pixel/KB range ke andar rakho — galat size par form rukta hai.

kit.title: Baaki documents PDF me
kit.text: Certificates ko 500 KB se chhoti saaf PDF files me rakho.

mistakes: Dusre UT ki notification par apply karna — J&K ke 1,356 pad aur Ladakh ke 41 pad alag notifications hain.
Capital aksharon me signature, ya hand-written ki jagah typed declaration.
Live photograph bhool jana — andhere kamre me ya kisi aur ke dwara form bharne par mismatch hota hai.
UT ke domicile certificate ke bina apply karke verification par reject hona.
steps: jkb.bank.in kholo, Careers me jao aur apne UT ke liye PO ya Banking Associate notification kholo.
Apni email aur mobile number se register karo.
Form bharo, photo upload karo aur achhi roshni me live photograph capture karo.
Signature, bayein angoothe ka nishan aur hand-written declaration exact pixel aur KB size me upload karo.
Fee online do (PO ₹1,200 / BA ₹800, aarakshit vargon ke liye kam) aur 26 November 2026 se pehle submit karo.
Registration number aur application print sambhal kar rakho.

extra_faq.q: Main J&K aur Ladakh se bahar rehta hoon — kya main apply kar sakta hoon?
extra_faq.a: Nahi. In notifications me sambandhit kendra shasit pradesh ka domicile anivarya hai — J&K ke pad J&K domiciles ke liye aur Ladakh ke pad Ladakh domiciles ke liye hain.

extra_faq.q: J&K Bank ki pariksha kaun karata hai?
extra_faq.a: Bank ki notifications ke anusar chayan prakriya IBPS ke madhyam se hoti hai — Banking Associate ke liye ek hi online pariksha, aur Probationary Officer ke liye Prelims + Mains + Interview.

note_en: These are contractual posts — the engagement is for 1 year initially and can be renewed on performance. It carries no claim to a regular government job.
note_hi: ये sanvida (contractual) pad hain — niyukti shuruaat me 1 saal ke liye hai aur pradarshan ke aadhar par aage badhayi ja sakti hai. Isse regular sarkari naukri ka koi daava nahi banta.

en.name: JRHMS Community Health Officer (CHO)
en.qual: B.Sc Nursing / Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing (integrated CPCH)
en.tagline: 1,038 Community Health Officer backlog posts for B.Sc Nursing candidates — apply by 22 November 2026. These are contractual posts.
en.fees_short: No fee stated in the notice
fees: The official notification does not state any application fee amount. If the portal shows a payment step while you apply, check the amount there before paying anything.
eligibility: Posts by category: UR 253, ST 280, SC 288, EWS 104, BC-II 58, BC-I 55 — backlog vacancies under Advt 05/2026/JRHMS-CHO-Integrated.

Education: B.Sc Nursing or Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing WITH the integrated Certificate Programme in Community Health (CPCH) curriculum, passed in or after the academic years 2016–2020, from a recognised college running the integrated curriculum. Registration with the nursing council is required as per the notification.
Maximum age as on 22 November 2026: General/EWS 35 years, BC-I/BC-II 37 years, Female (UR) 38 years, SC/ST 40 years; PH candidates get 10 years of extra relaxation.
Pay: a fixed ₹25,000 per month, plus a performance-based incentive of up to ₹15,000 per month.
Selection is as per NHM norms through document verification — the notification does not announce a written examination or interview for this engagement.
specs: The advertisement does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for on the upload screen.
Keep a recent colour photograph and a clear signature scan (signed on white paper) ready before you start.
Upload only clear, readable scans; a blurred photo or signature can get the form rejected.
dos: Check the integrated CPCH condition first — only the 2016–2020 batches with the integrated curriculum in their B.Sc Nursing are covered.
Keep your nursing council registration ready and valid.
Apply well before 22 November 2026 (11:59 PM) — no correction request is entertained afterwards.
Fill category details exactly as per your certificates; the posts are backlog vacancies by category.
Save the submitted application print for document verification.
donts: Do not treat this as a permanent post — it is a contractual engagement of 1 year, renewable on performance.
Do not apply if your B.Sc Nursing did not include the integrated CPCH curriculum.
Do not pay any fee amount that is not shown on the official portal — the notification states no fee.
Do not expect a correction window — the notification says correction requests will not be entertained.
Do not apply on any portal other than recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in.
checklist: B.Sc Nursing / Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing marksheets and degree scanned
Integrated CPCH certificate scanned
Nursing council registration certificate scanned
Caste certificate and Jharkhand domicile scanned, if applicable
10th certificate (age proof) scanned
Photo and signature scans ready
documents: B.Sc Nursing / Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing degree and marksheets
Certificate of the integrated CPCH curriculum

kit.title: Keep a passport photo ready
kit.text: Scan a recent colour photo on a light background; shrink an oversized file here first.

kit.title: Clean signature scan
kit.text: Sign on white paper and scan it clearly — a blurred signature can be rejected.

kit.title: Join certificates into one PDF
kit.text: Merge all documents into one clean PDF, ready for upload.

mistakes: Applying without the integrated CPCH curriculum in the nursing degree — the core eligibility of this advt.
Treating a contractual CHO engagement as a regular government post.
Missing the deadline because the window opened on 31 October and closes on 22 November 2026.
Entering a category different from the caste certificate — these are category-wise backlog posts.
steps: Read Advt 05/2026/JRHMS-CHO-Integrated on jrhms.jharkhand.gov.in.
Register on recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in and open the CHO application.
Fill your nursing qualification, CPCH and registration details carefully.
Upload photo, signature and certificates.
Submit before 22 November 2026, 11:59 PM and save the application print for document verification.

extra_faq.q: Is the JRHMS CHO post permanent?
extra_faq.a: No. It is a contractual engagement — initially for 1 year, renewable on performance — with a fixed pay of ₹25,000 per month plus a performance incentive of up to ₹15,000. It carries no claim to regularisation.

extra_faq.q: Is there a written exam for JRHMS CHO?
extra_faq.a: The notification does not announce a written exam or interview; selection follows NHM norms with document verification. Read the notification on jrhms.jharkhand.gov.in for the exact process.

hi.name: JRHMS Community Health Officer (CHO)
hi.qual: B.Sc Nursing / Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing (integrated CPCH)
hi.tagline: B.Sc Nursing ummeedwaron ke liye 1,038 Community Health Officer backlog pad — 22 November 2026 tak apply karo. Ye sanvida pad hain.
hi.fees_short: Notice me koi fee nahi di gayi
fees: Aadhikarik notification me koi application fee ki rashi nahi di gayi hai. Yadi apply karte samay portal par payment step dikhe, to kuch bhi dene se pehle wahan rashi check karo.
eligibility: Varg ke hisaab se pad: UR 253, ST 280, SC 288, EWS 104, BC-II 58, BC-I 55 — Advt 05/2026/JRHMS-CHO-Integrated ke तहत backlog riktiyan.

Shiksha: B.Sc Nursing ya Post-Basic B.Sc Nursing, JISME integrated Certificate Programme in Community Health (CPCH) curriculum shamil ho, shaikshanik varsh 2016–2020 me ya uske baad pass, integrated curriculum chalane wale manyata prapt college se. Notification ke anusar nursing council registration zaroori hai.
Adhiktaam aayu 22 November 2026 ko: General/EWS 35 saal, BC-I/BC-II 37 saal, Mahila (UR) 38 saal, SC/ST 40 saal; PH ummeedwaron ko 10 saal ki atirikt chhoot.
Vetan: nishchit ₹25,000 prati mahina, aur pradarshan aadharit protsahan ₹15,000 prati mahina tak.
Chayan NHM niyamo ke anusar document verification se hoga — notification me is niyukti ke liye koi likhit pariksha ya interview ghoshit nahi hai.
specs: Vigyapan me photo aur signature ke liye koi pakki KB size nahi di gayi hai — portal ki upload screen par jo format aur size manga jaye, usi me upload karo.
Form shuru karne se pehle nayi colour photograph aur safed kagaz par kiya saaf signature scan ready rakho.
Sirf saaf, padhi ja sakne wali scans upload karo; dhundli photo ya signature par form reject ho sakta hai.
dos: Sabse pehle integrated CPCH shart dekho — sirf 2016–2020 ke ve batch jinke B.Sc Nursing me integrated curriculum tha, isme aate hain.
Apna nursing council registration ready aur valid rakho.
22 November 2026 (raat 11:59) se achhi pehle apply karo — baad me koi correction request sweekar nahi hoti.
Varg ke vivaran apne certificates ke hisaab se hi bharo; ye varg ke hisaab se backlog pad hain.
Document verification ke liye submitted application ka print sambhalo.

Match the education level to the post: 12th for Head Constable, 10th for Constable.
Fill your sports achievements exactly as printed on the certificates.

Do not wait for a written exam stage — there is none in this recruitment.
Do not upload a blurred photo or signature; the notice treats it as a rejection ground.

Do not claim an achievement dated after 30 September 2026 or before 30 September 2024.

Pay the fee (₹370 or ₹250) online by 22 November 2026.

extra_faq.q: What is OTPR and is it compulsory?
extra_faq.a: OTPR is APPSC's One Time Profile Registration on psc.ap.gov.in. It is compulsory — the AEE application is filled through your OTPR profile, and one profile is used for all APPSC recruitments.

extra_faq.q: Is there negative marking in the APPSC AEE exam?
extra_faq.a: Yes. The Computer Based Test has 3 papers of 150 marks each (450 total), and each wrong answer carries −1/3 negative marking as per Notification 27/2026.

en.name: OPSC Assistant Section Officer (ASO)
en.tagline: 340 Assistant Section Officer posts in the Odisha Secretariat — applications open 9 November, last date 30 November 2026.
fees: ₹700 application fee for all candidates other than those exempt below.
SC and ST candidates of Odisha, and PwD candidates, are exempt from the fee.

eligibility: Posts by category: UR 144, SEBC 38, SC 81, ST 77 — with 114 posts for women. These are Group-B posts of the Odisha Secretariat Service Cadre under the Home Department.
Education: a Bachelor's degree in any discipline, adequate knowledge of computer applications, and the prescribed Odia language qualification — you must be able to read, write and speak Odia.
Age 21–42 years as on 1 January 2026 (born between 2 January 1984 and 1 January 2005). Relaxation: SEBC/SC/ST/Women/ESM +5 years, PwD +10 years.

Selection: a written examination of 400 marks — General Awareness, Reasoning & Mental Ability with Mathematics, English, and Odia — with −0.25 negative marking and per-paper qualifying marks (35% for UR/SEBC, 30% for SC/ST, 28% for PwD), followed by a Computer Skill Test of 50 marks (practical, qualifying at 40%). The final rank is on the written marks only. The written exam is tentatively on 17 January 2027.
Pay: ₹35,400 (Level-9, Cell-1 under ORSP Rules 2017) plus allowances.

Remember each paper has its own qualifying marks — a high total does not save a paper below the cut-off.
Appear in the exam if you want the fee back — the refund goes only to those who actually appear.
donts: Do not apply without the Odia qualification prescribed in the advertisement.
Do not treat the Computer Skill Test as optional — it is qualifying at 40% and compulsory to pass.

extra_faq.a: The ₹700 fee is refunded only to candidates who actually appear in the written examination. SC/ST candidates of Odisha and PwD candidates do not pay the fee at all.

en.tagline: 319 Engineer Trainee posts through GATE 2026 — Electrical 250, Civil 48, Computer Science 21. Last date 18 November 2026.
fees: ₹500 for candidates who are not exempt; the fee is not refunded.

Pay the fee online through the candidate login by 18 November 2026 — an application without the fee is rejected.
eligibility: Vacancies as per Vacancy Notice No. 2 dated 3 November 2026: Electrical 250, Civil 48, Computer Science 21 — 309 regular plus 10 backlog posts. There are NO Electronics posts in this notice, although the original advertisement had listed Electronics tentatively.

Maximum age 28 years as on 31 December 2025, with relaxations as per the advertisement.

Selection: GATE 2026 normalised marks carry 85% weightage, Group Discussion 3% and Interview 12%. There is no separate written test by POWERGRID. After one year of training, trainees are absorbed as Engineer (E2).

fees: ₹500 examination fee, paid online.

The fee is refunded to candidates who actually appear in the written test.
eligibility: Posts by category: UR 123, ST 67, SEBC 26, SC 22 — District Cadre Group-C posts under the Health & Family Welfare Department, spread over 29 districts.

Education: +2 Science, plus the 2-year COA or COSA course from a Government or Government-recognised institution of Odisha, and valid registration with the Ophthalmic Officers' Council, Odisha. Note: a Diploma or B.Sc in Optometry is NOT the qualifying qualification for this post under the detailed advertisement.
Language: the candidate must be able to read, write and speak Odia as prescribed.
Age 21–42 years as on 5 November 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST/SEBC/Women +5 years, PwD +10 years.
Selection: a written test of 100 marks — COA/COSA theory 60, practical skills 25, arithmetic 10, English 5 — then document verification and district allocation.
Pay: Level-7, ₹25,500–81,100 under ORSP Rules 2017.
Two deadlines apply: registration/re-registration closes on 29 November 2026, and the filled form must be finally submitted by 5 December 2026.
specs: The advertisement does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for on the upload screen.
Keep a recent colour photograph and a clear signature scan (signed on white paper) ready before you start.
Upload only clear, readable scans; a blurred photo or signature can get the form rejected.
dos: Register or re-register on osssc.gov.in by 29 November 2026 — the final submission date of 5 December does not extend registration.
Check your Ophthalmic Officers' Council, Odisha registration is valid before applying.
Apply only if your qualification is the COA/COSA course — optometry degrees/diplomas are not the prescribed qualification here.
Complete the final submission by 5 December 2026 and save the submitted copy.
Appear in the written test to become eligible for the fee refund.
donts: Do not confuse the two dates — registration ends 29 November, final submission 5 December.
Do not apply with a B.Sc/Diploma in Optometry assuming it is equivalent; the detailed advt prescribes COA/COSA.
Do not let an expired council registration spoil the application.
Do not apply on any site other than osssc.gov.in.
Do not skip the exam if you paid the fee — the refund is only for those who appear.

Education: full-time Degree, Diploma or ITI in a relevant discipline with at least 60% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD candidates against reserved seats). The qualifying result must not be older than 5 November 2021, candidates who have already completed an apprenticeship are not eligible, and those whose result was awaited on the cut-off date are not eligible.
Selection is purely on the merit of qualifying-examination percentage — there is no written test or interview; in a tie, the older candidate is placed higher.
Training is for 1 year and is not extendable. Stipend: Graduate ₹15,650/month, Diploma ₹13,450, ITI Trade ₹10,560.
specs: All supporting documents are uploaded clubbed into ONE single PDF of up to 10 MB on the RITES apprentice form — keep one clean combined PDF ready.

Submit both steps by 25 November 2026; portal enrolment alone is not an application.

Check the 60%/50% marks condition and the 5 November 2021 result cut-off before applying.
Keep the enrolment ID and the RITES form acknowledgement safe.

Do not apply if you have already done an apprenticeship anywhere.
Do not upload separate files one by one if the form asks for a single combined PDF.
Do not treat the apprenticeship as a route to a guaranteed RITES job.
Do not apply with a qualifying result older than 5 November 2021.

Class 10 marksheet and certificate (at least 50% aggregate)

donts: Do not submit more than one application — the notice says ALL applications of such a candidate will be rejected, with no fee refund.
Do not expect a correction window — no change of any kind is allowed after final submission.
Do not wear goggles, a cap or a wig in the photograph.
Do not sign in CAPITAL letters only.
Do not treat this training as a promise of a railway job.
dos: Keep the photo, signature and thumb impression each inside 10-50 KB in JPG format — one single band for all three.
Choose your cluster, unit and trade carefully — slots are cluster, unit and trade specific, and only one application is allowed.
Calculate your Class 10 and ITI percentages exactly as printed on the certificates — the merit list is the straight average of the two.
Apply well before the last date — the RRC itself warns that the website gets busy in the final days.
Save and print the submitted application and the fee payment slip for your records.
eligibility: Age: you should have completed 15 years and should not have completed 24 years as on 11 December 2026. Relaxations as per the notice — SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years.

Education: Class 10 (SSC/Matriculation) with at least 50% marks in aggregate from a recognised board, plus ITI in the relevant trade issued by NCVT/SCVT. Candidates still awaiting their Class 10 or ITI result on the notification date are NOT eligible.

Regular employees of the three power companies pay no fee.

eligibility: Posts: 1,501 in all — 195 Class-II posts (Advt 1/2026) and 1,306 Class-III & IV posts (Advt 2/2026). The notice itself does not print a grand total; 1,501 is the sum of the post-wise figures. The biggest post is Data Entry Operator — 609 seats across the three companies (CSPDCL 450, CSPGCL 95, CSPTCL 64).

Age as on 1 January 2026: minimum 21 years for Class-II and most Class-III posts, 18 years for Junior Engineer, Lab Technician, Radiographer, Dresser, ECG Technician, Attendant (Plant) and Fire Attendant. Maximum: 40 years for UR male (Chhattisgarh domicile), 45 for UR female and SC/ST/OBC; Fire Officer and Sub Fire Officer 30/35; Fire Attendant 25/30. Candidates from outside Chhattisgarh can apply only for Class-II posts, with a maximum age of 30.
Domicile: all Class-III and IV posts are only for Chhattisgarh domicile candidates. Class-II posts are open to candidates from outside the state too.

Education (post-wise): Assistant Engineer — 4-year B.E./B.Tech in the relevant branch; Junior Engineer — 3-year Diploma or engineering degree in the branch; Data Entry Operator — B.E./B.Tech or Master's in CS/IT, or B.Sc (CS/IT)/BCA, or any bachelor's degree plus a listed computer course; Medical Officer — MBBS with Medical Council of India registration; Accounts Officer — CA or CMA; Attendant (Plant) — 10th pass (Second Division) + 2-year ITI in the trade; Fire Attendant — 12th with Chemistry + NCC B/C certificate. Qualifications must be held on the last date of application.

Selection: online CBT — 2 hours, 100 MCQs (80 professional subject + 20 General Knowledge/English/Hindi/Reasoning or Quantitative Ability), −0.25 per wrong answer, qualifying 40% (UR/OBC) or 30% (SC/ST). Then, by post: interview (10 marks) for Assistant Engineer/Accounts/Medical/Programmer/Shift Chemist, physical fitness test for fire and security posts, typing/shorthand tests for Data Entry Operator and Stenographer, and document verification. CBT centres: Raipur, Bilaspur, Durg-Bhilai, Ambikapur and Jagdalpur.

Service conditions: after selection you sign a bond to serve the power companies for at least four years, with a security deposit — ₹3 lakh for Assistant Engineer-level posts, ₹2 lakh for Junior Engineer, ₹1 lakh for other Class-III posts, ₹50,000 for Class-IV. The National Pension System (NPS) applies after regularisation.
The whole recruitment is subject to the final outcome of SLP(C) 19668/2022 in the Supreme Court — category-wise numbers may change on that account.
dos: Check which Class your post is in before paying the fee — the fee is different for the two groups (₹800/₹700/₹600 vs ₹400/₹300/₹200).
If you are from outside Chhattisgarh, apply only for a Class-II post — Class-III and IV posts are CG-domicile only.
Give your company preferences (1st, 2nd, 3rd) for posts common to all three companies — no change of company is entertained later.
Apply before 26 November 2026, 11:55 PM — the form opens at 8 PM on 6 November and there is no correction window in the notice.
For Data Entry Operator and Stenographer, check the typing/shorthand requirement (5,000/10,000 key depressions per hour, shorthand 100 wpm) before applying.
donts: Do not apply for a Class-III or IV post if you are not a Chhattisgarh domicile candidate — the application will be rejected.
Do not apply for more than one branch in Assistant Engineer or Junior Engineer — only one branch is allowed.
Do not register twice for the same post — a duplicate registration can lead to cancellation without notice.
Do not carry a mobile phone, calculator or watch into the CBT hall — they are prohibited and can get you debarred.
Do not forget the 4-year service bond and security deposit — read the service conditions before you apply.

documents: Caste / non-creamy layer / income certificate (where applicable)

en.name: AEES Teacher Recruitment (Principal, PGT, TGT, PRT)
en.tagline: 254 teaching posts — Principal, Vice-Principal, PGT, TGT, Librarian, PRT and Balvatika — in Atomic Energy Education Society schools — last date 22 November 2026.
fees: ₹750 application fee + ₹250 processing fee = ₹1,000 in total.
Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates pay no application fee, but every applicant must pay the ₹250 processing fee — so ₹250 in total for them.
GST as applicable is charged extra by the bank. The fee is paid online only and is not refunded.
The fee is charged separately for each post applied for — and within PGTs you may apply for only one subject, and within TGTs for only one subject.
specs: The notice does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature — the sizes are given on the online application portal, so upload them in the format and size the portal asks for.
Recent colour photograph (JPG/JPEG; PNG also for Principal) and a clear signature scan; scan documents with a proper scanner, not a mobile phone camera, or the form may be rejected.
eligibility: Posts: 254 (tentative) — Principal 4, Vice-Principal 1, PGT 27, TGT 102, Librarian 13, Primary Teacher 89, Primary Teacher (Music) 10, Balvatika Teacher 8. Vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease.

Age (as on 22 November 2026): Principal 35–50 years; Vice-Principal 35–45; PGT 40 or below; TGT and Librarian 35 or below; PRT, PRT (Music) and Balvatika 30 or below. Minimum age 18. Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (NCL) 3 years, Women 10 years (PGT/TGT/Librarian/PRT/Balvatika), PwBD 10/13/15 years.

Education: Principal — Master's (50%) + B.Ed (50%) + 12 years' service as PGT or 3 years as Vice-Principal; Vice-Principal — Master's (50%) + B.Ed (50%) + 6 years as PGT; PGT — Master's in the subject (50%) + B.Ed (50%); TGT — Bachelor's in the subject (50%) + B.Ed (50%) + CTET Paper-II; Librarian — Bachelor's in Library Science (50%); PRT — 10+2 (50%) + D.El.Ed/B.El.Ed + CTET Paper-I; PRT (Music) — 10+2 (50%) + Bachelor's in Music/Performing Arts; Balvatika — 10+2 (50%, with English) + 2-year NTT/Pre-School/ECE diploma or B.Ed (Nursery).

CTET: a valid CTET certificate (issued on or before 22 November 2026) is essential for PRT and TGT posts (except Computer Science, Art Education and P&HE). CTET qualifying marks: 60% for UR, 55% for reserved categories.

Selection: Computer Based Test (MCQ, no negative marking) — Principal/Vice-Principal 150 questions/150 marks in 2 hours 30 minutes; PGT/TGT/Librarian/PRT 120 questions/120 marks in 2 hours. CBT qualifying: 60% (UR/EWS) or 54% (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD). Then a skill test (chalk-and-board teaching demo, Go/No Go) for PGT/TGT/Librarian/PRT, or an interview for Principal/Vice-Principal (50:50 CBT:interview). CBT centres in 44 cities; skill test/interview only at AEES, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai.
Posting: selected candidates may be posted at any of the 30 AEES schools across 15 centres in India. Probation: 2 years.
dos: Apply for only one subject within PGTs and only one subject within TGTs — but you may apply for different posts separately, paying the fee for each.
Check that your CTET certificate is valid and was issued on or before 22 November 2026 (for PRT and TGT).
Keep your Police Verification Certificate ready — it must not be older than 6 months at the skill test/interview.
Read the post-wise qualification in the official notice before applying — Principal and Vice-Principal need years of service, not just degrees.
Submit before 22 November 2026, 11:50 PM and save/print the confirmation page — the printout is needed at document verification.
donts: Do not apply for two PGT subjects or two TGT subjects — only one subject is allowed in each group.
Do not apply for PRT/TGT without a valid CTET certificate (except CS, Art and P&HE TGT).
Do not scan documents with a mobile phone camera — the notice says to use a proper scanner.
Do not send the printout of the confirmation page to AEES — keep it for document verification.
Do not wait for the last day — the fee and the form both close on 22 November 2026, 11:50 PM.

en.name: OLM Odisha Recruitment 2026
en.tagline: 1,115 contractual posts in 57 roles at Odisha Livelihoods Mission — Block Manager 453, Block Accountant 247, Block Mission Manager 174 — one CBT, no interview, last date 5 December 2026.
fees: Application fee: ₹500 for all candidates except SC, ST and PwD, paid online at registration.
SC, ST and PwD candidates pay nothing. The fee is not refunded.
specs: The notice does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature in the sources read — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for.
Keep the payment receipt and registration number safe — the fee is paid online at the time of registration.
eligibility: 1,115 contractual posts in 57 roles at state, district and block level — State 53, District 188, Block 874. Biggest: Block Manager 453, Block Accountant cum MIS Assistant 247, Block Mission Manager 174.
Age: 21–42 years as on 1 January 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST/SEBC/Women 5 years, PwD 10 years, ex-servicemen the period of defence service (up to 59 years); current OLM staff have no age limit.

Education: a Post Graduate / Master's degree in the field listed for the post, with 3+ or 5+ years of relevant experience. Block Accountant cum MIS Assistant needs B.Com with PGDCA / Computer Science / IT; Program Assistant needs a degree with PGDCA; two State Mission Executive posts need a Bachelor's in Veterinary Science or Fishery.
Selection: a single computer-based test (100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes — 120 minutes for PwD candidates), then a provisional merit list and document verification. There is no interview.

Pay (monthly remuneration): ₹16,560–₹72,450 depending on the post — State Project Manager ₹72,450, District Mission Manager ₹70,560, Block Mission Manager ₹31,338, Block Manager ₹19,080, Block Accountant cum MIS Assistant ₹20,700.
dos: Check the post-wise qualification and experience in the official advertisement before choosing a post — 57 roles have different requirements.
Apply only for posts whose experience you can prove — experience is counted as on the closing date.
Pay the ₹500 fee online during registration (SC/ST/PwD exempt) and save the receipt.
Submit before 5 December 2026, 11:55 PM — the portal closes at that time.
Read the domain-specific syllabus for your post — the CBT mixes a common syllabus with post-specific topics.
donts: Do not treat this as a permanent government job — these are contractual posts with no promise of regularisation.
Do not apply for a post whose qualification or experience you do not meet — conditions are checked as on the closing date.
Do not wait for the last day — the fee payment and the form are one online flow.
Do not assume an interview round — selection is CBT + merit list + document verification only.
checklist: Post chosen from the 57 roles (qualification + experience matched)
PG / Master's degree certificate and marksheets
Experience certificates for the required years
Caste / PwD certificate (if claiming exemption or relaxation)
Photo and signature in the portal's format
Online fee payment (₹500, unless exempt)
documents: PG / Master's degree certificate and marksheets
steps: Open the OLM recruitment link on missionshakti.odisha.gov.in
Choose your post from the 57 roles and check its qualification and experience
Register and fill the online form
Pay the fee online (₹500; SC/ST/PwD exempt)
Submit before 5 December 2026, 11:55 PM and save the acknowledgement

extra_faq.q: Is this a permanent government job?
extra_faq.a: No. These are contractual posts under the Odisha Livelihoods Mission, a registered society that runs the DAY-NRLM programme in Odisha. The advertisement gives no promise of regularisation.

extra_faq.q: How is selection done?
extra_faq.a: One computer-based test of 100 questions for 100 marks in 90 minutes (120 minutes for PwD candidates), followed by a provisional merit list and document verification. There is no interview.

extra_faq.q: What is the age limit?
extra_faq.a: 21–42 years as on 1 January 2026, with 5 years' relaxation for SC/ST/SEBC/Women, 10 years for PwD, and no age limit for current OLM staff.

hi.name: OLM ओडिशा भर्ती 2026
hi.tagline: ओडिशा आजीविका मिशन में 57 भूमिकाओं में 1,115 contractual पद — ब्लॉक मैनेजर 453, ब्लॉक अकाउंटेंट 247, ब्लॉक मिशन मैनेजर 174 — एक CBT, कोई साक्षात्कार नहीं, अंतिम तिथि 5 दिसंबर 2026।
hi.qual: PG / मास्टर डिग्री + 3–5 साल अनुभव (पद के अनुसार)
fees: आवेदन शुल्क: SC, ST और PwD को छोड़कर सभी उम्मीदवारों के लिए ₹500, पंजीकरण के समय ऑनलाइन भुगतान।
SC, ST और PwD उम्मीदवार कुछ नहीं भरते। शुल्क वापस नहीं होता।
specs: पढ़े गए स्रोतों में notice में फोटो और हस्ताक्षर का कोई निश्चित KB size नहीं छपा है — उन्हें portal के बताए format और size में upload करें।
भुगतान रसीद और पंजीकरण संख्या संभालकर रखें — शुल्क पंजीकरण के समय ऑनलाइन भरा जाता है।
eligibility: राज्य, ज़िला और ब्लॉक स्तर पर 57 भूमिकाओं में 1,115 contractual पद — राज्य 53, ज़िला 188, ब्लॉक 874। सबसे बड़े: ब्लॉक मैनेजर 453, ब्लॉक अकाउंटेंट सह MIS सहायक 247, ब्लॉक मिशन मैनेजर 174।
उम्र: 1 जनवरी 2026 को 21–42 वर्ष। छूट: SC/ST/SEBC/महिला 5 वर्ष, PwD 10 वर्ष, भूतपूर्व सैनिक सेवा की अवधि (अधिकतम 59 वर्ष तक); वर्तमान OLM कर्मचारियों के लिए कोई उम्र-सीमा नहीं।

शिक्षा: पद के लिए बताई गई शाखा में Post Graduate / मास्टर डिग्री, साथ में 3+ या 5+ साल का संबंधित अनुभव। ब्लॉक अकाउंटेंट सह MIS सहायक के लिए PGDCA / कंप्यूटर साइंस / IT के साथ B.Com; प्रोग्राम सहायक के लिए PGDCA के साथ स्नातक; दो स्टेट मिशन एग्ज़ीक्यूटिव पदों के लिए पशु चिकित्सा विज्ञान या मत्स्य पालन में स्नातक।
चयन: एक computer-based test (100 सवाल, 100 अंक, 90 मिनट — PwD उम्मीदवारों के लिए 120 मिनट), फिर अनंतिम मेधा सूची और दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन। कोई साक्षात्कार नहीं है।

वेतन (मासिक पारिश्रमिक): पद के अनुसार ₹16,560–₹72,450 — स्टेट प्रोजेक्ट मैनेजर ₹72,450, ज़िला मिशन मैनेजर ₹70,560, ब्लॉक मिशन मैनेजर ₹31,338, ब्लॉक मैनेजर ₹19,080, ब्लॉक अकाउंटेंट सह MIS सहायक ₹20,700।
dos: पद चुनने से पहले आधिकारिक विज्ञापन में उस पद की योग्यता और अनुभव जाँचो — 57 भूमिकाओं की ज़रूरतें अलग-अलग हैं।
सिर्फ़ उसी पद के लिए आवेदन करो जिसका अनुभव तुम साबित कर सकते हो — अनुभव अंतिम तिथि के हिसाब से गिना जाता है।
पंजीकरण के दौरान ₹500 शुल्क ऑनलाइन भरो (SC/ST/PwD छूट) और रसीद संभालो।
5 दिसंबर 2026, रात 11:55 से पहले submit करो — portal उसी समय बंद हो जाएगा।
अपने पद का domain-specific syllabus पढ़ो — CBT में common syllabus के साथ पद-विशेष विषय भी हैं।
donts: इसे स्थायी सरकारी नौकरी मत समझो — ये contractual पद हैं, नियमितीकरण का कोई वादा नहीं है।
जिस पद की योग्यता या अनुभव तुम पूरा नहीं करते, उसके लिए आवेदन मत करो — शर्तें अंतिम तिथि के हिसाब से जाँची जाती हैं।
आखिरी दिन का इंतज़ार मत करो — शुल्क भुगतान और फॉर्म एक ही ऑनलाइन प्रक्रिया है।
साक्षात्कार का चरण मत मानो — चयन सिर्फ़ CBT + मेधा सूची + दस्तावेज़ सत्यापन से है।

extra_faq.q: क्या यह स्थायी सरकारी नौकरी है?
extra_faq.a: नहीं। ये Odisha Livelihoods Mission के तहत contractual पद हैं — OLM एक registered society है जो Odisha में DAY-NRLM चलाती है। विज्ञापन में नियमितीकरण का कोई वादा नहीं है।

en.name: Cabinet Secretariat DFO (Technical)
en.tagline: 250 Deputy Field Officer (Technical) posts through GATE score — Group B, Level-7, about ₹1,00,000 a month — offline form by post, last date 15 November 2026.
fees: No application fee is specified in the notification — the only cost is downloading the form and sending it by ordinary post.
specs: Two recent passport-size colour photographs, with your name and date of birth written on the back, self-attested — the form is sent by post, so no KB sizes apply.
The application form must be typed on A-4 size paper and filled in English capital (block) letters, using black or blue ink only.
eligibility: 250 tentative vacancies for Deputy Field Officer (Technical), Group 'B', Non-Gazetted, Level-7 of the Pay Matrix — Computer Science/IT 112, Electronics/Communication 112, Data Science/AI 10, Physics 5, Mechanical 4, Civil 3, Chemistry 2, Mathematics 1, Statistics 1.

Education: a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology, or a Master's degree in Science, in one of the notified subjects — and a valid GATE Score Card with qualifying cut-off marks in GATE 2024, 2025 or 2026 in the matching subject.
Age: not more than 30 years as on the closing date, 15 November 2026. Relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, Central Government employees and ex-servicemen as per Central Government orders.

Selection: applications are ranked by valid GATE score for each subject separately; candidates are shortlisted at five times the vacancies and called for interview. Final selection is on GATE score + interview, followed by character and antecedent verification and a medical examination.

Pay: Level-7; total initial monthly emoluments including all allowances are about ₹1,00,000 for a posting in New Delhi. Initial posting is New Delhi, with field postings and All India transfer liability.
dos: Apply for only one subject — the one matching your degree and GATE paper.
Type the form on A-4 paper in English capital (block) letters with black or blue ink.
Send it by ordinary post so that it reaches Post Bag No. 001, Lodhi Road Head Post Office, New Delhi-110003 on or before 15 November 2026.
Attach self-attested copies of all documents — matriculation, 10+2, degree, GATE score card, caste certificate (if claiming relaxation) and Aadhaar.
Sign the declaration with date and place, and affix a self-attested recent passport-size colour photograph.
donts: Do not send the form by speed post or courier — the notification asks for ordinary post only.
Do not leave any column blank — unsigned or incomplete applications are summarily rejected.
Do not apply for more than one subject.
Do not assume an online form exists — there is no online application for this recruitment.

B.E./B.Tech or M.Sc degree and marksheets
Matriculation and 10+2 certificates (age proof)
Two recent passport-size colour photographs (name + DOB on back)

Aadhaar card copy
Envelope addressed to Post Bag No. 001, Lodhi Road HPO, New Delhi-110003
documents: Matriculation, 10+2 and degree marksheets and certificates

steps: Download the notification and the application form from the Cabinet Secretariat vacancies page (cabsec.gov.in)

extra_faq.q: Is there an online form for this recruitment?
extra_faq.a: No. Applications are accepted only offline, by ordinary post, to Post Bag No. 001, Lodhi Road Head Post Office, New Delhi-110003. The form must reach there on or before 15 November 2026.

extra_faq.q: Which GATE years are accepted?
extra_faq.a: A valid GATE score from 2024, 2025 or 2026, with qualifying cut-off marks in the GATE paper matching the subject you apply for.

extra_faq.q: Is there an application fee?
extra_faq.a: The notification does not specify any application fee — the only cost is downloading the form and the postage.

fees: Notice में कोई आवेदन शुल्क नहीं बताया गया है — सिर्फ़ फॉर्म download करने और साधारण डाक से भेजने का खर्च है।
specs: दो हालिया passport-size रंगीन फोटो, पीछे अपना नाम और जन्मतिथि लिखकर self-attest करें — फॉर्म डाक से जाता है, इसलिए कोई KB size लागू नहीं होता।
आवेदन पत्र A-4 size कागज़ पर type करके अंग्रेज़ी capital (block) अक्षरों में भरना है, सिर्फ़ काली या नीली स्याही से।
eligibility: Deputy Field Officer (तकनीकी) के 250 संभावित पद, Group 'B', Non-Gazetted, Pay Matrix Level-7 — कंप्यूटर साइंस/IT 112, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स/संचार 112, डेटा साइंस/AI 10, भौतिकी 5, मैकेनिकल 4, सिविल 3, रसायन 2, गणित 1, सांख्यिकी 1।

शिक्षा: notified विषयों में से एक में इंजीनियरिंग या तकनीक में स्नातक डिग्री, या विज्ञान में मास्टर डिग्री — और संबंधित विषय में GATE 2024, 2025 या 2026 में qualifying cut-off अंकों के साथ मान्य GATE Score Card।
उम्र: अंतिम तिथि 15 नवंबर 2026 को अधिकतम 30 वर्ष। SC, ST, OBC, केंद्र सरकार के कर्मचारियों और भूतपूर्व सैनिकों को केंद्र सरकार के आदेशों के अनुसार छूट।

चयन: हर विषय के लिए आवेदन मान्य GATE score से क्रमबद्ध होंगे; पदों से पाँच गुना उम्मीदवार साक्षात्कार के लिए shortlist होंगे। अंतिम चयन GATE score + साक्षात्कार से होगा, फिर चरित्र व पूर्ववृत्त सत्यापन और चिकित्सा परीक्षा।
वेतन: Level-7; नई दिल्ली posting पर सभी भत्तों सहित शुरुआती मासिक परिलब्धियाँ लगभग ₹1,00,000। शुरुआती posting नई दिल्ली, field posting और अखिल भारतीय transfer दायित्व के साथ।
dos: सिर्फ़ एक विषय के लिए आवेदन करो — जो तुम्हारी डिग्री और GATE paper से मेल खाता हो।
फॉर्म A-4 कागज़ पर अंग्रेज़ी capital (block) अक्षरों में काली या नीली स्याही से type करके भरो।
इसे साधारण डाक से भेजो ताकि यह 15 नवंबर 2026 को या उससे पहले Post Bag No. 001, Lodhi Road Head Post Office, New Delhi-110003 पहुँच जाए।
सभी दस्तावेज़ों की self-attested प्रतियाँ लगाओ — मैट्रिक, 10+2, डिग्री, GATE score card, जाति प्रमाणपत्र (छूट का दावा हो तो) और आधार।
घोषणा पर तिथि और स्थान के साथ हस्ताक्षर करो और self-attested हालिया passport-size रंगीन फोटो चिपकाओ।
donts: फॉर्म speed post या courier से मत भेजो — notice में सिर्फ़ साधारण डाक माँगी गई है।
कोई column खाली मत छोड़ो — बिना हस्ताक्षर या अधूरे आवेदन तुरंत खारिज हो जाते हैं।
एक से ज़्यादा विषयों के लिए आवेदन मत करो।
ऑनलाइन फॉर्म है ऐसा मत मानो — इस भर्ती के लिए कोई ऑनलाइन आवेदन नहीं है।

extra_faq.a: नहीं। आवेदन सिर्फ़ offline, साधारण डाक से स्वीकार होते हैं — Post Bag No. 001, Lodhi Road Head Post Office, New Delhi-110003। फॉर्म 15 नवंबर 2026 को या उससे पहले वहाँ पहुँचना चाहिए।

en.name: Supreme Court Junior Court Attendant
en.tagline: 130 Junior Court Attendant posts in the Supreme Court of India — Class 10 pass can apply, objective test + interview, Level-3 pay ₹21,700–69,100, last date 25 November 2026.
fees: Application fee: ₹1,500 for General/Unreserved candidates, plus bank charges, paid online through the UCO Bank payment gateway.
SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), ex-servicemen and physically challenged candidates pay ₹750, plus bank charges. The fee is never refunded.
specs: The notice does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature in the sources read — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for.
Upload scanned copies of your Class X and XII certificates, caste/community certificate (if claiming reservation) and disability certificate (if applicable) with the form.
eligibility: 130 tentative vacancies for Junior Court Attendant (Group 'C', Non-Clerical), Level 3 of the Pay Matrix — ₹21,700–69,100 plus allowances. The number may change as per the Registry's requirements.
Education: minimum Class X (10th) pass and maximum Class XII (10+2) from a board or institute recognised by the Government. Candidates with education above Class 12 are not eligible.

Age: 18–27 years as on 1 October 2026. Relaxation as per Government of India rules for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), physically challenged and ex-servicemen; up to 5 years extra for dependants of freedom fighters; widows, divorced women and women judicially separated (not remarried) up to 35 years (38 for OBC, 40 for SC/ST). No upper age limit for departmental candidates of the Supreme Court Registry.

Selection: an objective-type test (100 questions, 100 marks, 1½ hours — 25 each on General Intelligence & Reasoning, Numerical Aptitude, General English and General Awareness; −0.25 per wrong answer; minimum qualifying marks 50), then an interview (25 marks, minimum 13). If many candidates qualify, interviews are held in a 1:3 ratio by merit.

Exam: the objective-type test is tentatively scheduled for 26 December 2026. Answer keys will be uploaded on 28 December 2026; objections can be filed on 28–29 December 2026 at ₹100 per objection (refunded if the objection is valid).
dos: Check the Class 10 minimum / Class 12 maximum rule before applying — education above Class 12 makes you ineligible.
Keep your application number safe — admit cards are downloaded only from sci.gov.in, never sent by post.
Pay the fee online through the UCO Bank gateway and keep the receipt.
Submit before 25 November 2026, 11:55 PM — the application cannot be withdrawn or modified after submission.
Choose your test cities in order of preference — the Registry may shift you to another city for administrative reasons.
donts: Do not apply if you have studied above Class 12 — the notice caps qualification at Class 12.
Do not submit more than one form — only the last-submitted form is considered.
Do not expect a correction window — a submitted application cannot be withdrawn or modified.
Do not expect TA/DA for the test or interview — none is payable.
checklist: Class X certificate (date-of-birth proof)
Class XII certificate (if passed)
Caste/community certificate (if claiming reservation)
Disability certificate (if applicable)
Photo and signature in the portal's format
Fee payment (₹1,500 / ₹750 + bank charges)
steps: Open the Junior Court Attendant recruitment link on sci.gov.in
Register and fill the online form with correct particulars — check everything before final submission
Upload the photo, signature and certificates
Pay the fee online through the UCO Bank gateway (₹1,500; ₹750 for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/ESM/PwD, plus bank charges)
Submit before 25 November 2026, 11:55 PM, preview the form and take a printout for your records

extra_faq.q: Can graduates apply for this post?
extra_faq.a: No. The notification caps the qualification at Class XII (10+2) — candidates with education above Class 12 are not eligible. The minimum is a Class X pass.

extra_faq.q: Is there negative marking in the test?
extra_faq.a: Yes. Each question carries 1 mark and 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer. The minimum qualifying marks are 50 out of 100 in the objective test and 13 out of 25 in the interview.

extra_faq.q: Can I correct the form after submitting?
extra_faq.a: No. The notification says an application once submitted cannot be withdrawn or modified — so check every field before final submission.

hi.name: सर्वोच्च न्यायालय जूनियर कोर्ट अटेंडेंट
hi.tagline: भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय में जूनियर कोर्ट अटेंडेंट के 130 पद — 10वीं पास आवेदन कर सकते हैं, objective test + साक्षात्कार, Level-3 वेतन ₹21,700–69,100, अंतिम तिथि 25 नवंबर 2026।
fees: आवेदन शुल्क: General/Unreserved उम्मीदवारों के लिए ₹1,500, बैंक शुल्क अलग, UCO Bank payment gateway से ऑनलाइन भुगतान।
SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), भूतपूर्व सैनिक और दिव्यांग उम्मीदवार ₹750 भरते हैं, बैंक शुल्क अलग। शुल्क कभी वापस नहीं होता।
specs: पढ़े गए स्रोतों में notice में फोटो और हस्ताक्षर का कोई निश्चित KB size नहीं छपा है — उन्हें portal के बताए format और size में upload करें।
फॉर्म के साथ Class X और XII के प्रमाणपत्र, जाति/समुदाय प्रमाणपत्र (आरक्षण का दावा हो तो) और दिव्यांगता प्रमाणपत्र (जहाँ लागू हो) की scanned प्रतियाँ upload करें।
eligibility: जूनियर कोर्ट अटेंडेंट (Group 'C', Non-Clerical) के 130 संभावित पद, Pay Matrix Level 3 — ₹21,700–69,100 व भत्ते। Registry की आवश्यकता के अनुसार संख्या बदल सकती है।
शिक्षा: सरकार से मान्यता प्राप्त बोर्ड/संस्थान से न्यूनतम Class X (10वीं) पास और अधिकतम Class XII (10+2)। 12वीं से ऊपर की शिक्षा वाले उम्मीदवार पात्र नहीं हैं।

उम्र: 1 अक्टूबर 2026 को 18–27 वर्ष। SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), दिव्यांग और भूतपूर्व सैनिकों को भारत सरकार के नियमों के अनुसार छूट; स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों के आश्रितों को 5 वर्ष अतिरिक्त; विधवाएँ, तलाकशुदा महिलाएँ और न्यायिक रूप से अलग (पुनर्विवाह न करने वाली) महिलाएँ 35 वर्ष तक (OBC 38, SC/ST 40)। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय Registry के विभागीय उम्मीदवारों के लिए कोई ऊपरी उम्र-सीमा नहीं।

चयन: objective-type test (100 सवाल, 100 अंक, 1½ घंटे — सामान्य बुद्धि व तर्क, संख्यात्मक अभिरुचि, सामान्य अंग्रेज़ी और सामान्य जागरूकता में 25-25; गलत उत्तर पर −0.25; न्यूनतम अर्हता अंक 50), फिर साक्षात्कार (25 अंक, न्यूनतम 13)। अगर कई उम्मीदवार अर्हता पाते हैं तो मेधा क्रम से 1:3 अनुपात में साक्षात्कार होगा।

परीक्षा: objective-type test संभावित रूप से 26 दिसंबर 2026 को होगी। Answer keys 28 दिसंबर 2026 को upload होंगी; आपत्तियाँ 28–29 दिसंबर 2026 को ₹100 प्रति आपत्ति पर दर्ज की जा सकती हैं (आपत्ति सही पाए जाने पर राशि वापस होगी)।
dos: आवेदन से पहले 10वीं न्यूनतम / 12वीं अधिकतम का नियम जाँचो — 12वीं से ऊपर की शिक्षा तुम्हें अपात्र बना देती है।
आवेदन संख्या संभालकर रखो — प्रवेश पत्र सिर्फ़ sci.gov.in से download होंगे, डाक से कभी नहीं भेजे जाएँगे।
शुल्क UCO Bank gateway से ऑनलाइन भरो और रसीद रखो।
25 नवंबर 2026, रात 11:55 से पहले submit करो — आवेदन submit होने के बाद वापस नहीं लिया जा सकता और न बदला जा सकता है।
परीक्षा शहर अपनी पसंद के क्रम में चुनो — Registry प्रशासनिक कारणों से तुम्हें दूसरे शहर में भी भेज सकती है।
donts: 12वीं से ऊपर पढ़ाई की हो तो आवेदन मत करो — notice में योग्यता 12वीं तक ही सीमित है।
एक से ज़्यादा फॉर्म मत भरो — सिर्फ़ आखिरी बार submit किया गया फॉर्म माना जाएगा।
correction window की उम्मीद मत रखो — submit हुआ आवेदन वापस नहीं लिया जा सकता और न बदला जा सकता है।
परीक्षा या साक्षात्कार के लिए TA/DA की उम्मीद मत रखो — कोई TA/DA देय नहीं है।

Class XII प्रमाणपत्र (पास हो तो)

extra_faq.q: क्या स्नातक इस पद के लिए आवेदन कर सकते हैं?
extra_faq.a: नहीं। Notice में योग्यता Class XII (10+2) तक ही सीमित है — 12वीं से ऊपर की शिक्षा वाले उम्मीदवार पात्र नहीं हैं। न्यूनतम योग्यता 10वीं पास है।

extra_faq.q: क्या परीक्षा में negative marking है?
extra_faq.a: हाँ। हर सवाल 1 अंक का है और हर गलत उत्तर पर 0.25 अंक काटे जाते हैं। न्यूनतम अर्हता अंक objective test में 100 में से 50 और साक्षात्कार में 25 में से 13 हैं।

extra_faq.q: क्या submit के बाद फॉर्म सुधारा जा सकता है?
extra_faq.a: नहीं। Notice कहती है कि एक बार submit हुआ आवेदन वापस नहीं लिया जा सकता और न बदला जा सकता है — इसलिए अंतिम submit से पहले हर field जाँचो।
