en.name: AFMS SSC Medical Officer
en.tagline: 120 Medical Officer posts on Short Service Commission in the Armed Forces Medical Services — MBBS + NEET PG, interview in Delhi, Captain's pay, last date 18 November 2026.
fees: Application processing fee: ₹200 for all candidates, paid online (internet banking / credit card / debit card).
The fee is non-refundable. Save the online payment transaction number for future correspondence.
specs: Photo: up to 100 KB in JPEG format.
Class X / birth certificate: PDF up to 200 KB. Also upload the MBBS attempt certificate, internship certificate, NEET PG scorecard, PG degree (if any) and Aadhaar.
eligibility: 120 Medical Officer (Short Service Commission) posts — 90 for male and 30 for female candidates — in the Army, Navy and Air Force. Separate merit lists are prepared for male and female candidates.

Education: MBBS (medical qualification included in the National Medical Commission Act, 2019) with permanent registration from any State Medical Council / NMC / MCI. Final MBBS (Part I & II) passed in not more than two attempts. Internship must be complete on or before 30 September 2026.

NEET PG: candidates must have appeared in NEET PG in the last two years (2025 or 2026). Civilian doctors with a PG degree need not appear again — their earlier NEET PG marks are considered. Candidates pursuing PG must have their final PG result declared by 18 November 2026.
Age: MBBS holders below 30 years and PG degree holders below 35 years as on 31 December 2026 (born on or after 2 January 1997 for MBBS, 2 January 1992 for PG).

Selection: shortlisting on NEET PG marks (percentile converted to calculated marks out of 200), then an interview at Army Hospital (Research & Referral), Delhi Cantt from 2 December 2026 (50 marks — viva-voce 47 + NCC weightage up to 3; minimum 50% to qualify), then a medical examination by the Special Medical Board. Final merit = NEET PG marks + interview marks.
Pay: Captain (or equivalent in Navy / Air Force), Level 10B of the Defence Pay Matrix — Basic Pay ₹61,300 + Military Service Pay ₹15,500, plus HRA, NPA, transport, dress and dearness allowances.
dos: Check your NEET PG 2025 or 2026 scorecard before registering — shortlisting is on NEET PG marks.
Keep your permanent medical registration, internship completion certificate and MBBS attempt certificate ready.
Register on join.afms.gov.in between 9 and 18 November 2026 and pay the ₹200 fee online.
Carry originals plus two photocopies to the interview — candidates without originals are not eligible even if shortlisted.
Note the helpline 011-24199857 (10 AM–4 PM, Monday to Friday) for queries.
donts: Do not apply without a NEET PG 2025 or 2026 appearance (unless you hold a PG degree with earlier NEET PG marks).
Do not apply if your internship is incomplete after 30 September 2026.
Do not miss the 18 November 2026 deadline — registration closes that day.
Do not treat this as a permanent commission at entry — it is a Short Service Commission of 5 years, extendable by 9 more.
checklist: MBBS degree + permanent medical registration
NEET PG 2025/2026 scorecard
Internship completion certificate (by 30 Sep 2026)
MBBS attempt / transcript certificate
Class X / birth certificate (PDF up to 200 KB)
Photo up to 100 KB (JPEG)

₹200 fee payment
documents: MBBS degree and PG degree (if any)
steps: Visit join.afms.gov.in and click 'NEW REGISTRATION'
Fill the form and upload the photo (up to 100 KB), certificates and NEET PG scorecard
Pay the ₹200 processing fee online
Submit before 18 November 2026 and save the application and payment transaction number
Download the admit card from the website at least one week before the interview (from 2 December 2026, Army Hospital (R&R), Delhi Cantt)

extra_faq.q: Is NEET PG compulsory for this recruitment?
extra_faq.a: Yes, except for civilian doctors who already hold a PG degree — their earlier NEET PG marks are considered. Others must have appeared in NEET PG 2025 or 2026.

extra_faq.q: Is this a permanent job?
extra_faq.a: No, it is a Short Service Commission with an initial tenure of 5 years, extendable by 9 more years (5 + 4). A permanent commission is possible later only through the departmental examination.

extra_faq.q: Where is the interview held?
extra_faq.a: At Army Hospital (Research & Referral), Delhi Cantt, from 2 December 2026 onwards (tentative). The admit card is available on join.afms.gov.in at least one week before the interview.

hi.name: AFMS SSC मेडिकल ऑफिसर
hi.tagline: सशस्त्र सेना चिकित्सा सेवा में Short Service Commission पर मेडिकल ऑफिसर के 120 पद — MBBS + NEET PG, दिल्ली में साक्षात्कार, कैप्टन का वेतन, अंतिम तिथि 18 नवंबर 2026।
fees: आवेदन processing शुल्क: सभी उम्मीदवारों के लिए ₹200, ऑनलाइन भुगतान (internet banking / credit card / debit card)।
शुल्क वापस नहीं होता। आगे के पत्राचार के लिए ऑनलाइन भुगतान transaction number संभालकर रखो।
specs: फोटो: JPEG format में अधिकतम 100 KB।
Class X / जन्म प्रमाणपत्र: PDF अधिकतम 200 KB। साथ में MBBS attempt प्रमाणपत्र, internship प्रमाणपत्र, NEET PG scorecard, PG डिग्री (हो तो) और आधार भी upload करें।
eligibility: मेडिकल ऑफिसर (Short Service Commission) के 120 पद — पुरुष 90 और महिला 30 — थल सेना, नौसेना और वायु सेना में। पुरुष और महिला उम्मीदवारों की अलग-अलग मेधा सूची बनेगी।

शिक्षा: MBBS (National Medical Commission Act, 2019 में शामिल चिकित्सा योग्यता) साथ में किसी भी राज्य चिकित्सा परिषद / NMC / MCI से स्थायी पंजीकरण। Final MBBS (Part I व II) अधिकतम दो attempts में पास। Internship 30 सितंबर 2026 को या उससे पहले पूरी होनी चाहिए।

NEET PG: उम्मीदवारों को पिछले दो सालों (2025 या 2026) में NEET PG में शामिल होना चाहिए। PG डिग्री वाले civilian डॉक्टरों को दोबारा नहीं देना है — उनके पहले के NEET PG अंक माने जाएँगे। PG कर रहे उम्मीदवारों का final PG result 18 नवंबर 2026 तक घोषित होना चाहिए।
उम्र: 31 दिसंबर 2026 को MBBS धारकों की उम्र 30 वर्ष से कम और PG डिग्री धारकों की 35 वर्ष से कम (MBBS के लिए 2 जनवरी 1997 को या उसके बाद जन्म, PG के लिए 2 जनवरी 1992 को या उसके बाद जन्म)।

चयन: NEET PG अंकों पर shortlisting (percentile को 200 में से calculated अंकों में बदला जाता है), फिर 2 दिसंबर 2026 से Army Hospital (Research & Referral), दिल्ली Cantt में साक्षात्कार (50 अंक — viva-voce 47 + NCC weightage अधिकतम 3; अर्हता के लिए न्यूनतम 50%), फिर Special Medical Board से चिकित्सा परीक्षा। अंतिम मेधा = NEET PG अंक + साक्षात्कार अंक।
वेतन: कैप्टन (या नौसेना / वायु सेना में समकक्ष), Defence Pay Matrix Level 10B — Basic Pay ₹61,300 + Military Service Pay ₹15,500, साथ में HRA, NPA, transport, dress और महँगाई भत्ते।
dos: पंजीकरण से पहले अपना NEET PG 2025 या 2026 scorecard जाँचो — shortlisting NEET PG अंकों पर होती है।
स्थायी चिकित्सा पंजीकरण, internship completion प्रमाणपत्र और MBBS attempt प्रमाणपत्र तैयार रखो।
9 से 18 नवंबर 2026 के बीच join.afms.gov.in पर पंजीकरण करो और ₹200 शुल्क ऑनलाइन भरो।
साक्षात्कार में originals के साथ दो photocopies ले जाओ — originals के बिना उम्मीदवार shortlist होने पर भी पात्र नहीं रहते।
सवालों के लिए helpline 011-24199857 (सुबह 10–शाम 4, सोमवार से शुक्रवार) नोट करो।
donts: NEET PG 2025 या 2026 में शामिल हुए बिना आवेदन मत करो (PG डिग्री वालों को छोड़कर, जिनके पहले के NEET PG अंक माने जाएँगे)।
अगर internship 30 सितंबर 2026 के बाद भी अधूरी है तो आवेदन मत करो।
18 नवंबर 2026 की deadline मत चूको — पंजीकरण उसी दिन बंद हो जाएगा।
इसे शुरुआत में स्थायी commission मत समझो — यह 5 साल की Short Service Commission है, जो 9 साल और बढ़ सकती है।

extra_faq.q: क्या इस भर्ती के लिए NEET PG अनिवार्य है?
extra_faq.a: हाँ, उन civilian डॉक्टरों को छोड़कर जिनके पास पहले से PG डिग्री है — उनके पहले के NEET PG अंक माने जाएँगे। बाकियों को NEET PG 2025 या 2026 में शामिल होना चाहिए।

extra_faq.q: क्या यह स्थायी नौकरी है?
extra_faq.a: नहीं, यह 5 साल की शुरुआती tenure वाली Short Service Commission है, जो 9 साल और (5 + 4) बढ़ सकती है। स्थायी commission बाद में सिर्फ़ विभागीय परीक्षा से मिल सकता है।

extra_faq.q: साक्षात्कार कहाँ होगा?
extra_faq.a: Army Hospital (Research & Referral), दिल्ली Cantt में, 2 दिसंबर 2026 से (संभावित)। Admit card साक्षात्कार से कम से कम एक हफ्ते पहले join.afms.gov.in पर मिलेगा।

note_en: These are contractual posts under the Centrally Sponsored Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension (ATMA Scheme) — not permanent government jobs. There is no written examination; selection is by API score and interview.
note_hi: Ye kendra-prayojit Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension (ATMA Yojana) ke tahat samvida (contractual) pad hain — sthayi sarkari naukri nahi. Isme likhit pariksha nahi hai; chayan API score aur sakshatkar se hoga.

en.name: Manipur Agriculture BTM & ATM
en.tagline: 138 Block Technology Manager and Assistant Technology Manager posts in Manipur Agriculture under the ATMA scheme — no written exam, API score + interview, last date 26 November 2026.
en.qual: PG (BTM) / Graduate (ATM) in Agriculture or allied sector
fees: Processing fee: ₹800 for UR candidates, ₹500 for ST/SC/OBC candidates, paid online with the application.
PwD candidates are exempt from the fee.
specs: The notice does not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature in the sources read — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for.
The API score calculator is provided on the Department's website — use it to check your score before applying.
eligibility: 138 contractual posts — Block Technology Manager (BTM) 69 and Assistant Technology Manager (ATM) 69 — under the Centrally Sponsored Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension (ATMA Scheme). One-third (23) of the posts in each cadre are reserved for women.
BTM: Post Graduate in Agriculture / Allied sector with computer skills. ATM: Graduate in Agriculture / Allied sector. The notice mentions no experience requirement for either post.
Age: the maximum age limit is as per State Government Rules / Policy — the notice does not print the age in years or a cut-off date.

Selection: no written examination. Candidates are shortlisted for interview in a 3:1 ratio on the basis of their Academic Performance Indicator (API) score — API 70 marks + interview 30 marks, total 100. The interview date will be notified later.
Pay (consolidated remuneration): BTM ₹30,000 per month, ATM ₹25,000 per month. No allowances are mentioned in the notice. The number of posts may increase or decrease.
dos: Calculate your API score on the Department website's calculator before applying — shortlisting is on API score.
Check the post-wise category break-up (UR 36, OBC 11, SC 1, ST 21 per post) before choosing.
Pay the processing fee online (UR ₹800, ST/SC/OBC ₹500, PwD exempt) with the form.
Submit before 26 November 2026.
Watch the Department website for the interview date — it will be notified later.
donts: Do not expect a written exam — there is none; selection is API score + interview.
Do not treat this as a permanent government job — it is contractual under the ATMA scheme.
Do not apply for BTM without a Post Graduate degree in Agriculture or an allied sector.
Do not assume an age limit in years — the notice leaves it to State Government Rules/Policy.

Calculate your API score with the calculator on the website
Fill the online form in the prescribed format
Pay the processing fee online (UR ₹800, ST/SC/OBC ₹500, PwD exempt)
Submit before 26 November 2026 and save the acknowledgement

extra_faq.q: Is there a written exam?
extra_faq.a: No. Candidates are shortlisted for interview in a 3:1 ratio on their Academic Performance Indicator (API) score — 70 marks for the API score and 30 for the interview.

extra_faq.q: Is this a permanent job?
extra_faq.a: No. Both posts are contractual appointments under the Centrally Sponsored Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension (ATMA Scheme).

extra_faq.q: What is the age limit?
extra_faq.a: The notice does not print the age in years — it says the maximum age limit shall be as per State Government Rules / Policy.

hi.name: मणिपुर कृषि BTM व ATM
hi.tagline: ATMA योजना के तहत मणिपुर कृषि में ब्लॉक टेक्नोलॉजी मैनेजर और असिस्टेंट टेक्नोलॉजी मैनेजर के 138 पद — कोई लिखित परीक्षा नहीं, API score + साक्षात्कार, अंतिम तिथि 26 नवंबर 2026।
hi.qual: कृषि या संबद्ध क्षेत्र में PG (BTM) / स्नातक (ATM)
fees: Processing शुल्क: UR उम्मीदवारों के लिए ₹800, ST/SC/OBC उम्मीदवारों के लिए ₹500, आवेदन के साथ ऑनलाइन भुगतान।
PwD उम्मीदवार शुल्क से छूट प्राप्त हैं।

API score calculator विभाग की website पर दिया गया है — आवेदन से पहले उससे अपना score जाँचो।
eligibility: 138 contractual पद — ब्लॉक टेक्नोलॉजी मैनेजर (BTM) 69 और असिस्टेंट टेक्नोलॉजी मैनेजर (ATM) 69 — केंद्र-प्रायोजित Sub-Mission on Agriculture Extension (ATMA योजना) के तहत। हर cadre में एक-तिहाई (23) पद महिलाओं के लिए आरक्षित हैं।
BTM: कंप्यूटर skills के साथ कृषि / संबद्ध क्षेत्र में Post Graduate। ATM: कृषि / संबद्ध क्षेत्र में स्नातक। Notice में किसी भी पद के लिए अनुभव की ज़रूरत नहीं बताई गई है।
उम्र: अधिकतम उम्र-सीमा राज्य सरकार के नियमों / नीति के अनुसार होगी — notice में उम्र वर्षों में या cut-off तिथि नहीं छपी है।

चयन: कोई लिखित परीक्षा नहीं। Academic Performance Indicator (API) score के आधार पर 3:1 अनुपात में साक्षात्कार के लिए shortlist होगा — API 70 अंक + साक्षात्कार 30 अंक, कुल 100। साक्षात्कार की तिथि बाद में बताई जाएगी।
वेतन (समेकित पारिश्रमिक): BTM ₹30,000 प्रति माह, ATM ₹25,000 प्रति माह। Notice में कोई भत्ता नहीं बताया गया है। पदों की संख्या बढ़ या घट सकती है।
dos: आवेदन से पहले विभाग की website के calculator से अपना API score निकालो — shortlisting API score पर ही होती है।
चुनने से पहले पद-वार श्रेणी विभाजन जाँचो (हर पद में UR 36, OBC 11, SC 1, ST 21)।
processing शुल्क फॉर्म के साथ ऑनलाइन भरो (UR ₹800, ST/SC/OBC ₹500, PwD छूट)।
26 नवंबर 2026 से पहले submit करो।
साक्षात्कार की तिथि के लिए विभाग की website देखते रहो — वह बाद में बताई जाएगी।
donts: लिखित परीक्षा की उम्मीद मत रखो — कोई परीक्षा नहीं है; चयन API score + साक्षात्कार से है।

en.name: SMC Deputy & Assistant Town Planner
en.tagline: 70 Deputy and Assistant Town Planner posts at Surat Municipal Corporation — fresh applications 16–30 November 2026, Level-9 and Level-8 pay, last date 30 November 2026.
fees: Application fee: ₹500 for Unreserved candidates, paid online by debit card, credit card or net banking.
Reserved categories (Women, SEBC, EWS, SC, ST) and PwD candidates pay ₹400. The fee is non-refundable after the online application is filed.
specs: Photo: up to 150 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG.
Signature: up to 50 KB.
eligibility: 70 vacancies under the revised advertisement PRO/320/2026-27 — Deputy Town Planner 14 and Assistant Town Planner 56. (The revised notice also corrects Assistant Engineer (Electrical) to 53 posts, but no fresh application is invited for that post.)

Education (both posts): M.Arch. / M.E. (Civil) / B.Arch. / B.E. (Civil) / M.Plan / B.Plan from a recognised university, plus a Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in City / Town / Regional Planning from a recognised institute, or membership of the Institute of Town Planners after passing its examination. Basic computer application knowledge and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi (or both) are required.

Experience: Deputy Town Planner needs a minimum of 5 years of relevant Town Planning experience after the qualifying degree (only an experience certificate on the employer's letterhead is valid — an offer or appointment letter is not accepted). Assistant Town Planner needs no experience.

Age: Deputy Town Planner not more than 45 years, Assistant Town Planner not more than 35 years, as on 30 November 2026. Relaxation for reserved-category candidates originally from Gujarat as per Government rules (overall age not above 45 years); no age limit for SMC regular-pay employees.
Pay: Deputy Town Planner Level-9, ₹53,100–1,67,800; Assistant Town Planner Level-8, ₹44,900–1,42,400. Women get 33% horizontal reservation within each category.

Selection: applications are shortlisted on qualification and eligibility; a written, practical or oral test is held at the Municipal Commissioner's discretion; a waiting list is prepared by the Staff Selection Committee for direct recruitment to the vacant posts.
dos: Apply only if you did NOT apply under the March 2026 advertisement PRO/739 — those candidates need not apply again.
For Deputy Town Planner, keep a proper experience certificate on the employer's letterhead (nature of work, designation, dates, salary) ready — an offer letter will not work.
Register on suratmunicipal.gov.in from 16 November 2026, 11:00 AM and verify your email and mobile by OTP.
Submit one application per cadre — if you submit more than one for the same cadre, only the last confirmed one counts and the earlier fee is forfeited.
Submit before 30 November 2026, 11:00 PM.
donts: Do not reapply if you already applied for these cadres under PRO/739 (March 2026).
Do not apply for Assistant Engineer (Electrical) under this notice — its vacancy count was only revised.
Do not expect a correction window — changes are not entertained after final submission; a fresh form (and fresh fee) is needed.
Do not upload a photo above 150 KB or a signature above 50 KB.
checklist: Degree (M.Arch/M.E.(Civil)/B.Arch/B.E.(Civil)/M.Plan/B.Plan) + PG planning diploma or ITPI membership
Deputy Town Planner: 5 years' Town Planning experience certificate on letterhead
Age proof (birth / school leaving certificate)
Caste / SEBC / EWS / PwD certificate (Gujarat formats, where applicable)
Photo up to 150 KB, signature up to 50 KB
Fee payment (₹500 / ₹400)
documents: Degree and PG planning diploma / ITPI membership certificate
Experience certificate (Deputy Town Planner, on letterhead)
Caste / Non-Creamy Layer / EWS / PwD certificate (where applicable)
steps: Visit suratmunicipal.gov.in from 16 November 2026, 11:00 AM
Download and read the official advertisement PRO/320/2026-27
Register with email and mobile, verify by OTP, and complete your profile
Click Apply Now against Deputy Town Planner or Assistant Town Planner and fill the form
Upload the photo (up to 150 KB) and signature (up to 50 KB), preview, confirm and pay the fee
Submit before 30 November 2026, 11:00 PM and download the payment receipt

extra_faq.q: I applied under the March 2026 SMC advertisement. Should I apply again?
extra_faq.a: No. Candidates who applied for Deputy Town Planner or Assistant Town Planner under PRO/739 (11 March 2026) do not need to apply again — this notice only opens a fresh window for new applicants.

extra_faq.q: What is the last date to apply?
extra_faq.a: 30 November 2026, 11:00 PM. Applications open on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

extra_faq.q: Is there a correction window?
extra_faq.a: No. Changes to a submitted form are not entertained — if you need a correction, you must file a new form and the earlier fee is forfeited.

हस्ताक्षर: अधिकतम 50 KB।
eligibility: संशोधित विज्ञापन PRO/320/2026-27 के तहत 70 पद — डिप्टी टाउन प्लानर 14 और असिस्टेंट टाउन प्लानर 56। (संशोधित notice में असिस्टेंट इंजीनियर (इलेक्ट्रिकल) के पद 53 भी सुधरे हैं, लेकिन उस पद के लिए कोई नया आवेदन नहीं माँगा गया है।)

अनुभव: डिप्टी टाउन प्लानर के लिए योग्यता वाली डिग्री के बाद Town Planning का न्यूनतम 5 साल का संबंधित अनुभव (सिर्फ़ नियोक्ता के letterhead पर अनुभव प्रमाणपत्र मान्य है — offer या appointment letter स्वीकार नहीं होगा)। असिस्टेंट टाउन प्लानर के लिए कोई अनुभव ज़रूरी नहीं।

150 KB से बड़ी फोटो या 50 KB से बड़े हस्ताक्षर upload मत करो।

en.name: SBI Manager & Deputy Manager (Security)
en.tagline: 60 Specialist Cadre Officer posts at State Bank of India — Manager (Security) and Deputy Manager (Security) for ex-armed-forces and paramilitary officers, online test + interview, last date 25 November 2026.
fees: Application fee and intimation charges: ₹750 for UR, EWS and OBC candidates, paid online.
SC and ST candidates pay no fee. The fee is non-refundable.
specs: Photo: recent passport-style colour picture, light-coloured (preferably white) background — 20–50 KB, 200×230 pixels (preferred). A live photograph is also captured through webcam or mobile phone during the application.
Signature: black ink on white paper — 10–20 KB, 140×60 pixels (preferred). Signature in capital letters is not accepted.
Left-hand thumb impression (JPG) and handwritten declaration in English, black ink on white paper — 800×400 pixels, 50–100 KB. Declaration in capital letters is not accepted.
Supporting documents: PDF, A4 page size, up to 500 KB per file.
eligibility: 60 regular Specialist Cadre Officer vacancies — Manager (Security) in MMGS-III and Deputy Manager (Security) in MMGS-II, combined total (UR 25, OBC 16, SC 9, EWS 6, ST 4). The number is provisional.
Education: graduation in any discipline from a Government-recognised university or institution. Graduation alone is not enough — the service experience below is mandatory.

Manager (Security): an officer not below the rank of Major in the Indian Army (or equivalent in Navy/Air Force) with at least 10 years of commissioned service, or not below Deputy Commandant in paramilitary forces with at least 10 years of service as an officer.

Deputy Manager (Security): an officer not below the rank of Captain in the Indian Army (or equivalent in Navy/Air Force) with at least 5 years of commissioned service, or not below Assistant Commandant in paramilitary forces with at least 5 years of service as an officer.

Age: 25–40 years as on 31 October 2026, with relaxation for reserved categories as per Government of India guidelines (cumulative relaxation is not available). Only candidates with medical fitness in SHAPE-1 or an equivalent medical category as on the advertisement date are eligible.

Selection: an online written test (200 objective questions, 200 marks, 2 hours — Reasoning 50Q/25 marks, English 50Q/50 marks, General Awareness 50Q/25 marks, Professional Knowledge 50Q/100 marks; only Professional Knowledge counts for merit; no negative marking), then an interview of 100 marks. Final merit is 70% Professional Knowledge + 30% interview. Tentative schedule: call letters December 2026, online exam December 2026 / January 2027, interview January / February 2027, final result February 2027.
Pay: Manager (Security) ₹85,920–1,05,820; Deputy Manager (Security) ₹64,820–93,960, plus DA, HRA, CCA, PF/NPS, LFC and medical facility. Probation: 6 months.
dos: Check the rank and service-length rule for your post before applying — graduation alone does not qualify you.
Keep your discharge book / service record ready — your SHAPE-1 (or equivalent) medical category must be uploaded.
Upload the photo (20–50 KB), signature (10–20 KB), thumb impression and handwritten declaration in the exact sizes.
Capture the live photograph through webcam or mobile phone when the form asks for it.
Submit and pay before 25 November 2026 — editing is allowed only until fee payment, not after.
donts: Do not apply as a fresh graduate — this recruitment is only for officers with the prescribed armed-forces or paramilitary service.
Do not sign in capital letters — signatures and handwritten declarations in capitals are not accepted.
Do not send a hard copy of the application — SBI accepts online applications only.
Do not expect a correction window — no change or editing is allowed after the fee is paid.
checklist: Graduation degree + marksheets

hi.tagline: भारतीय स्टेट बैंक में स्पेशलिस्ट कैडर ऑफिसर के 60 पद — मैनेजर (सुरक्षा) और डिप्टी मैनेजर (सुरक्षा) भूतपूर्व सशस्त्र बल और अर्धसैनिक अधिकारियों के लिए, ऑनलाइन test + साक्षात्कार, अंतिम तिथि 25 नवंबर 2026।
fees: आवेदन शुल्क व सूचना शुल्क: UR, EWS और OBC उम्मीदवारों के लिए ₹750, ऑनलाइन भुगतान।
SC और ST उम्मीदवार कोई शुल्क नहीं भरते। शुल्क वापस नहीं होता।
specs: फोटो: हालिया passport-style रंगीन तस्वीर, हल्का (अधिमानतः सफेद) background — 20–50 KB, 200×230 pixels (अधिमानतः)। आवेदन के दौरान webcam या mobile phone से live फोटो भी ली जाती है।
हस्ताक्षर: सफेद कागज़ पर काली स्याही से — 10–20 KB, 140×60 pixels (अधिमानतः)। Capital letters में हस्ताक्षर स्वीकार नहीं होता।
बाएँ हाथ के अँगूठे का निशान (JPG) और अंग्रेज़ी में हस्तलिखित घोषणा, सफेद कागज़ पर काली स्याही से — 800×400 pixels, 50–100 KB। Capital letters में घोषणा स्वीकार नहीं होती।
सहायक दस्तावेज़: PDF, A4 page size, प्रति file अधिकतम 500 KB।
eligibility: 60 नियमित स्पेशलिस्ट कैडर ऑफिसर पद — MMGS-III में मैनेजर (सुरक्षा) और MMGS-II में डिप्टी मैनेजर (सुरक्षा), कुल मिलाकर (UR 25, OBC 16, SC 9, EWS 6, ST 4)। संख्या अनंतिम है।
शिक्षा: सरकार से मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय या संस्थान से किसी भी विषय में स्नातक। सिर्फ़ स्नातक काफ़ी नहीं है — नीचे बताई गई सेवा का अनुभव अनिवार्य है।

मैनेजर (सुरक्षा): भारतीय सेना में मेजर (या नौसेना/वायु सेना में समकक्ष) से कम रैंक के नहीं, कम से कम 10 साल की कमीशन सेवा के साथ, या अर्धसैनिक बलों में डिप्टी कमांडेंट से कम नहीं, अधिकारी के रूप में कम से कम 10 साल की सेवा के साथ।

डिप्टी मैनेजर (सुरक्षा): भारतीय सेना में कैप्टन (या नौसेना/वायु सेना में समकक्ष) से कम रैंक के नहीं, कम से कम 5 साल की कमीशन सेवा के साथ, या अर्धसैनिक बलों में असिस्टेंट कमांडेंट से कम नहीं, अधिकारी के रूप में कम से कम 5 साल की सेवा के साथ।

उम्र: 31 अक्टूबर 2026 को 25–40 वर्ष, आरक्षित श्रेणियों को भारत सरकार के दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार छूट (cumulative छूट उपलब्ध नहीं)। सिर्फ़ वही उम्मीदवार पात्र हैं जिनकी विज्ञापन तिथि को SHAPE-1 या समकक्ष चिकित्सा श्रेणी में medical fitness है।

चयन: ऑनलाइन लिखित परीक्षा (200 objective सवाल, 200 अंक, 2 घंटे — Reasoning 50Q/25 अंक, English 50Q/50 अंक, General Awareness 50Q/25 अंक, Professional Knowledge 50Q/100 अंक; मेधा के लिए सिर्फ़ Professional Knowledge गिनी जाती है; कोई negative marking नहीं), फिर 100 अंकों का साक्षात्कार। अंतिम मेधा 70% Professional Knowledge + 30% साक्षात्कार। संभावित schedule: call letter दिसंबर 2026, ऑनलाइन परीक्षा दिसंबर 2026 / जनवरी 2027, साक्षात्कार जनवरी / फरवरी 2027, अंतिम result फरवरी 2027।
वेतन: मैनेजर (सुरक्षा) ₹85,920–1,05,820; डिप्टी मैनेजर (सुरक्षा) ₹64,820–93,960, साथ में DA, HRA, CCA, PF/NPS, LFC और चिकित्सा सुविधा। Probation: 6 महीने।

फॉर्म माँगे तो webcam या mobile phone से live फोटो capture करो।
25 नवंबर 2026 से पहले submit करो और शुल्क भरो — editing सिर्फ़ शुल्क भुगतान तक ही मुमकिन है, उसके बाद नहीं।
donts: नए स्नातक के रूप में आवेदन मत करो — यह भर्ती सिर्फ़ निर्धारित सशस्त्र बल या अर्धसैनिक सेवा वाले अधिकारियों के लिए है।

extra_faq.q: क्या नया स्नातक आवेदन कर सकता है?
extra_faq.a: नहीं। सिर्फ़ स्नातक काफ़ी नहीं है — तुम्हें निर्धारित रैंक का अधिकारी होना चाहिए, साथ में सशस्त्र बल या अर्धसैनिक बलों में 5 साल (डिप्टी मैनेजर) या 10 साल (मैनेजर) की कमीशन सेवा और SHAPE-1 चिकित्सा fitness।

en.name: APSSB CSLE MTS 2026
en.tagline: 93 Multi-Tasking Staff posts in Arunachal Pradesh through the Combined Secondary Level Examination — Class 10 pass can apply, written exam 20 December 2026, last date 23 November 2026.
fees: Examination fee: ₹150 for General / APST candidates, paid online only (debit card / credit card / net banking / UPI). The fee is non-refundable.
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) pay nothing.
specs: Photo: recent passport-size colour photograph, 50–100 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG.
Signature: scanned on white paper with a black ink pen, 10–50 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG.
eligibility: 93 Group 'C' Multi-Tasking Staff vacancies — MTS 70, Peon 8, Cook 6, Chowkidar 2, Sweeper 3, Dak Runner 1, Duftry 1, Helper 1, Mali 1 — across departments and Deputy Commissioner offices in Arunachal Pradesh (APST 70, UR 23; PwBD 1, ex-servicemen 4).

Education: Class X (10th) pass / ITI or equivalent from a recognised board or institution. Candidates must hold a Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh, an APST certificate (for the APST quota), and proficiency in any local indigenous tribal language of Arunachal Pradesh.

Age: 18–35 years as on 23 November 2026. Relaxation: APST candidates 5 years (up to 40 years), PwBD candidates 15 years; ex-servicemen and departmental candidates as per Government of Arunachal Pradesh rules.

Selection: a single-stage objective-type multiple-choice written examination — 100 questions, 200 marks (2 marks per question), 2 hours. Subjects: General Awareness, Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, English Language & Comprehension (50 marks each). No negative marking; minimum qualifying marks 33% aggregate.
Exam: the tentative written examination date is 20 December 2026 (Sunday). Pay: Pay Level-1, ₹18,000–56,900 per month plus DA, HRA, transport and other allowances.
dos: Check the PRC and local tribal language requirements before applying — both are mandatory.

Print the submitted form and payment receipt after submission.
donts: Do not apply without an Arunachal Pradesh PRC — it is a mandatory eligibility condition.
Do not miss the 3:00 PM deadline on 23 November 2026 — the form closes in the afternoon, not at midnight.
Do not assume negative marking — there is none, but you need 33% aggregate to qualify.
Do not skip the post-code and centre preferences — they are part of the form.

extra_faq.q: Who can apply for APSSB CSLE MTS?
extra_faq.a: Class 10 pass / ITI candidates who hold a Permanent Residence Certificate of Arunachal Pradesh and are proficient in a local indigenous tribal language of the state. APST candidates need the APST certificate for the APST quota.

extra_faq.q: Is there negative marking in the written exam?
extra_faq.a: No. The 100-question, 200-mark paper has no negative marking, but candidates need at least 33% aggregate to qualify.

extra_faq.q: When is the written exam?
extra_faq.a: Tentatively on 20 December 2026 (Sunday). The exact date and admit-card details will be announced on apssb.nic.in.

en.name: APPSC Group 2 Services 2026
en.tagline: 720 Group-II posts in Andhra Pradesh — 471 Executive and 249 Non-Executive, 30 post codes — graduates can apply online, Screening Test on 21 February 2027, last date 11 December 2026.
en.qual: Bachelor's degree + APPSC One Time Profile Registration (OTPR)
fees: Processing fee: ₹250 for all candidates, plus examination fee ₹80 — SC, ST, BC, PwBD and ex-servicemen of Andhra Pradesh are exempt from the ₹80 examination fee. Total ₹330 (₹250 for exempt categories). Confirmed in the detailed notification No. 37/2026, dated 10 November 2026.
Pay the fee online on psc.ap.gov.in before 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM.
specs: The sources read do not print fixed KB or pixel sizes for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the portal asks for.
Complete your One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) on psc.ap.gov.in before applying — the application needs it.
eligibility: 720 Group-II vacancies (471 Executive + 249 Non-Executive) across 30 post codes — including Deputy Tahsildar, Deputy Mandal Parishad Development Officer (MPDO), Senior Accountant and Assistant Section Officer. The detailed notification No. 37/2026, dated 10 November 2026, carries the category-wise break-up.
Education: a Bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Post-wise qualifications are in the detailed notification No. 37/2026 (10 November 2026).

Age: 18–42 years as on the date of the detailed notification (10 November 2026) (general category). Relaxation: BC 3 years (up to 45), SC/ST 5 years (up to 47), PwBD 10 years (up to 52), as per Andhra Pradesh government rules. Prohibition & Excise Sub-Inspector and Assistant Registrar carry lower upper-age limits — check the detailed notification.

Selection: Screening Test (offline OMR) on 21 February 2027 → Main Examination (two papers) → Computer Proficiency Test. Pay scales range from ₹25,220–80,910 (Junior Accountant) to ₹45,830–1,30,580 (Municipal Commissioner Gr-III, Deputy MPDO and others).
Apply online only on psc.ap.gov.in from 10 November to 11 December 2026 (up to 11:59 PM). Applications by any other mode are not entertained.
dos: Complete your OTPR on psc.ap.gov.in first — the form cannot be submitted without it.
Read the detailed notification No. 37/2026 (10 November 2026) for the final fee, age and post-wise qualifications before you pay.
Check the post-wise pay scale and duties before choosing your preferences — 30 post codes differ widely.
Submit before 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM — the portal closes at that time.
Save the application number and fee receipt after submitting.
donts: Do not apply by post or any offline mode — only online forms on psc.ap.gov.in count.
Do not treat the 720 figure as final — it is provisional and may change after departmental confirmation.
Do not pay any fee figure seen on other websites — the confirmed fee is ₹250 + ₹80 in the detailed notification.
Do not wait for the last day — the portal slows down near the deadline.

APPSC One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) completed
Caste / PwD / ex-servicemen certificate (if claiming relaxation or exemption)

Post preferences chosen from the 30 post codes
steps: Open psc.ap.gov.in and complete your One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) if you have not already
Open the Group-II Services recruitment link (Notification No. 37/2026)
Read the detailed notification for final fee, age and post-wise qualifications
Fill the online form and choose your post preferences
Pay the fee online (₹250 + ₹80; ₹80 exempt for SC/ST/BC/PwBD/ESM)
Submit before 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM and save the acknowledgement

extra_faq.q: What is the last date to apply for APPSC Group 2 Services 2026?
extra_faq.a: 11 December 2026, up to 11:59 PM, online only on psc.ap.gov.in. The application window opened on 10 November 2026.

extra_faq.q: What is the fee for APPSC Group 2?
extra_faq.a: Processing fee ₹250 for all candidates plus examination fee ₹80. SC, ST, BC, PwBD and ex-servicemen of Andhra Pradesh are exempt from the ₹80 examination fee. Confirmed in the detailed notification No. 37/2026 (10 November 2026).

extra_faq.q: What is the age limit for APPSC Group 2?
extra_faq.a: 18–42 years as on 10 November 2026, the date of the detailed notification (general category), with relaxation up to 45 for BC, 47 for SC/ST and 52 for PwBD. Some posts (Prohibition & Excise Sub-Inspector, Assistant Registrar) have lower upper-age limits.

720 की संख्या को अंतिम मत समझो — यह अस्थायी है, विभागीय पुष्टि के बाद बदल सकती है।

en.name: Nagaland Police Constable (GD) 2026
en.tagline: 1,137 Constable (GD) posts in Nagaland Police for Indigenous Naga tribes — Class 6/8 pass can apply, PET + written test + interview, last date 30 November 2026.
en.qual: Class 6 pass (Backward Tribes) / Class 8 pass (other Naga tribes) + Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate
fees: Examination fee: ₹300 for all candidates, paid online. The fee is non-refundable.
specs: The sources read do not print a fixed KB size for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the recruitment portal asks for.
Keep your Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate and tribe certificate ready — both are checked at application.
eligibility: 1,137 Constable (GD) vacancies — 1,053 regular (Male 848, Female 205) distributed across 14 districts by the approved tribal ratio, plus 84 backlog posts (all male) for specific tribes.

Only for Indigenous Inhabitant Tribes of Nagaland. Apply for ONE eligible district only. Candidates need a valid Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate and Scheduled Tribe certificate from the competent authority.
Education: Class 6 pass for Backward Tribes; Class 8 pass (or higher) for other eligible Naga tribes, from a recognised board or authority.
Age: 18–37 years as on 14 October 2026 (advertisement date). Serving government employees get relaxation equal to qualifying service (maximum 5 years).

Selection: Physical/Medical Standards Test (qualifying) → PET (45 marks: running, pull-ups, high jump, long jump) → written examination (80 MCQ, 40 marks, 2 hours, English) → interview (10 marks) → NCC certificate marks (up to 5). Total merit 100. Height: male 5 ft 3 in, female 5 ft; chest male 31/33 in, female 29/31 in.
Pay: Pay Level-3 (₹5,200–20,200 + Grade Pay ₹1,800). Probation 2 years; initial deployment in India Reserve (IR) Battalions.
dos: Check your district and tribe allocation in the notification before choosing a district — only one district is allowed.
Keep your Indigenous Inhabitant and tribe certificates ready before you start the form.

extra_faq.q: Who can apply for Nagaland Police Constable (GD) 2026?
extra_faq.a: Only male and female candidates belonging to the Indigenous Inhabitant Tribes of Nagaland, with Class 6 pass (Backward Tribes) or Class 8 pass (other Naga tribes), aged 18–37 years as on 14 October 2026. Each candidate may apply for only one eligible district.

extra_faq.q: What is the selection process?
extra_faq.a: Physical/Medical Standards Test (qualifying), then PET (45 marks), written examination (80 MCQ, 40 marks, 2 hours, English), interview (10 marks) and NCC certificate marks (up to 5) — total merit 100.

extra_faq.q: What is the salary of a Nagaland Police Constable?
extra_faq.a: Pay Level-3 — pay band ₹5,200–20,200 with Grade Pay ₹1,800, plus allowances. Probation is 2 years, with initial deployment in India Reserve (IR) Battalions.

वेतन: पे लेवल-3 (₹5,200–20,200 + ग्रेड पे ₹1,800)। परिवीक्षा 2 साल; शुरुआती तैनाती India Reserve (IR) बटालियन में।

₹300 शुल्क ऑनलाइन भरो और 30 नवंबर 2026 से पहले submit करो।

donts: अगर तुम नागालैंड की मूल निवासी जनजाति से नहीं हो तो आवेदन मत करो — गैर-जनजातीय उम्मीदवार पात्र नहीं हैं।

आखिरी दिन का इंतज़ार मत करो — portal 30 नवंबर 2026 को बंद हो जाएगा।

eligibility: 256 Chief Minister's Fellow positions under the Chief Minister's Atmanirbhar Asom Abhijan (CMAAA), Industries, Commerce & Public Enterprise Department, Government of Assam. The number may change as per CMAAA Society requirements.

Education: MBA, MBA-equivalent, or a Master's degree in Social Sciences, Public Policy or Development Studies from a reputed university/institution, with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying PG degree. The 60% rule applies only to the PG degree, not to Class 10/12 or graduation.

Skills: proficiency in Assam's local languages, English and Hindi, strong oral and written communication, and working knowledge of computer applications. Preference (not mandatory) for IIM/IIT/IRMA/TISS/NIRD graduates and professionals on sabbatical from MNCs or international organisations.
Selection: application shortlisting → group discussion → interview. No written examination. Selected Fellows are expected to join in December 2026, after orientation and exposure visits.
Remuneration: ₹6,00,000 per annum in year 1 (including ₹96,000 travel) and ₹6,60,000 in year 2 (including ₹1,08,000 travel) — about ₹50,000 and ₹55,000 a month. Posting across Assam.

Keep the CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula from your university ready, if your marks are in CGPA.
Be ready to work across Assam with district officials, banks and entrepreneurs.
Submit before 14 November 2026, 11:59 PM through the Niyukti portal.
Save the submitted application — the portal also lets you reprint it later.
donts: Do not treat this as a permanent government job — it is a 24-month fellowship with six-monthly performance reviews.
Do not assume any application fee — the notification specifies none; follow the portal.
Do not apply with less than 60% in your PG degree — the cut-off is mandatory.
Do not use the CMAAA beneficiary (financial assistance) application — use the separate Chief Minister's Fellow link.

कौशल: असम की स्थानीय भाषाओं, अंग्रेज़ी और हिंदी में दक्षता, मज़बूत मौखिक और लिखित संवाद, और कंप्यूटर एप्लीकेशन का कामकाजी ज्ञान। IIM/IIT/IRMA/TISS/NIRD स्नातकों और MNC/अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठनों से sabbatical पर आए पेशेवरों को प्राथमिकता (अनिवार्य नहीं)।

fees: Application fee: ₹750 for General Merit and Category 2A/2B/3A/3B; ₹500 for SC/ST/Category-1/ex-servicemen/transgender; ₹250 for Persons with Disabilities. Pay online by 29 November 2026 — the fee is non-refundable.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Home Science, Social Work or Sociology, or B.Sc in Home Science/Community Science. The degree marks card or certificate must be in hand by the last date — result-awaited candidates are not eligible, and no other qualification is accepted.

Age: 18–40 years as on the last date of application (General Merit); 43 years for Category 2A/2B/3A/3B; 45 years for SC/ST/Category-1. Pay: ₹44,425–83,700, probation 2 years, National Pension Scheme (NPS) applies.

eligibility: 171 महिला सुपरवाइज़र (महिला मेलविचारकियारु) ग्रुप-C पद — शेष मूल संवर्ग 141 (सीधी 134 + सेवारत 7) और कल्याण कर्नाटक 30 (सीधी 28 + सेवारत 2)। सेवारत पद महिला एवं बाल विकास विभाग की महिला कर्मचारियों के लिए हैं; न भरे तो सामान्य उम्मीदवारों को मिलेंगे। सिर्फ़ महिला उम्मीदवार।

शिक्षा: होम साइंस, सोशल वर्क या सोशियोलॉजी में स्नातक डिग्री, या होम साइंस/कम्युनिटी साइंस में B.Sc। अंतिम तिथि तक डिग्री अंकतालिका या प्रमाणपत्र हाथ में होना चाहिए — परिणाम की प्रतीक्षा वाली उम्मीदवार पात्र नहीं हैं, और कोई अन्य योग्यता स्वीकार नहीं होगी।

उम्र: आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि को 18–40 वर्ष (सामान्य मेधा); श्रेणी 2A/2B/3A/3B के लिए 43 वर्ष; SC/ST/श्रेणी-1 के लिए 45 वर्ष। इन सीमाओं में 29 जनवरी 2026 के सरकारी आदेश के तहत एकमुश्त 5 साल की छूट शामिल है। आगे की छूट: PwD, विधवा और मुक्त बंधुआ मज़दूर 10 वर्ष; कर्नाटक सरकारी कर्मचारी सेवा वर्ष या 10 वर्ष, जो कम हो; भूतपूर्व सैनिक सेवा + 3 वर्ष।

चयन: लिखित प्रतियोगी परीक्षा — पेपर-1 सामान्य ज्ञान (100 सवाल, 100 अंक, 2 घंटे) और पेपर-2 विशिष्ट पेपर (100 सवाल, 100 अंक, 2 घंटे), गलत उत्तर पर −0.25, अर्हता के लिए न्यूनतम 35% — फिर अनिवार्य कन्नड़ भाषा परीक्षा 8 जनवरी 2027 (दोपहर 3–5 बजे, 150 अंक, अर्हता के लिए 50; अंक मेधा में नहीं गिने जाएँगे)। छूट अगर SSLC या उससे ऊपर कन्नड़ पहली/दूसरी भाषा थी, या उम्मीदवार ने कन्नड़ माध्यम में पढ़ाई की हो।
वेतन: ₹44,425–83,700, परिवीक्षा 2 साल, राष्ट्रीय पेंशन योजना (NPS) लागू।
dos: जाँचो कि तुम्हारी डिग्री ठीक होम साइंस, सोशल वर्क या सोशियोलॉजी में है (या B.Sc होम साइंस/कम्युनिटी साइंस) — कोई अन्य डिग्री पात्र नहीं है।
फॉर्म ध्यान से भरो — submit के बाद कोई बदलाव नहीं हो सकता।
शुल्क 29 नवंबर 2026 तक ऑनलाइन भरो (फॉर्म बंद होने के एक दिन बाद तक)।
8 जनवरी 2027 की अनिवार्य कन्नड़ भाषा परीक्षा की तैयारी करो, जब तक छूट न हो।
सभी सेमेस्टर की डिग्री अंकतालिकाएँ तैयार रखो।
donts: अगर तुम पुरुष उम्मीदवार हो तो आवेदन मत करो — ये पद सिर्फ़ महिलाओं के लिए आरक्षित हैं।
अंतिम डिग्री परिणाम की प्रतीक्षा में आवेदन मत करो — परिणाम-प्रतीक्षित उम्मीदवार पात्र नहीं हैं।

शुल्क की deadline (29 नवंबर 2026) मत चूको — बिना शुल्क फॉर्म अधूरा है।

en.name: Odisha SSB Laboratory Assistant-cum-Storekeeper 2026
en.tagline: 435 Laboratory Assistant-cum-Storekeeper posts in Odisha's degree colleges — Honours graduates can apply online, single written test only, no interview, last date 16 November 2026.
en.qual: Bachelor's degree with Honours in the relevant practical subject + Odia language ability
fees: Application fee: ₹500 for all candidates except SC/ST/PwD, who pay ₹200. Pay online only — the fee is non-refundable.
The fee must be paid by 16 November 2026, 11:45 PM, along with the final submission.
specs: Upload a latest passport-size photo taken within the last 15 days, a scanned signature and a left-hand thumb impression.
The sources read do not print fixed KB or pixel sizes for the photo and signature — upload them in the format and size the ssbodisha.ac.in portal asks for.
eligibility: 435 vacancies — 57 in Government Degree Colleges and 378 in Non-Government Aided Colleges. Group-B, Level-9 (ORSP 2017).
Education: a Bachelor's degree with Honours in the relevant practical subject from a recognised university.
You must be a resident of Odisha and able to speak, read and write Odia (Odia as a subject in HSC, or the ME-standard Odia test).
Age: 21–42 years as on 1 January 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST/SEBC/women/ex-servicemen +5 years, PwD +10 years.

Selection: a single written test only — 100 multiple-choice questions, 150 marks, 2 hours, +1.5 for a correct answer and −0.5 for a wrong one. Qualifying marks: 40% for UR, 30% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD. There is no interview.
Apply online only on ssbodisha.ac.in from 12 October 2026 (2:30 PM) to 16 November 2026 (11:45 PM). There is no correction window — no change is possible after final submission.
dos: Check that your Honours subject matches the practical subject of the post before applying.
Keep your Odia language proof ready — it is a compulsory requirement.
Upload a photo taken within the last 15 days, not an old one.
Pay the fee (₹500, or ₹200 for SC/ST/PwD) online before the final submit.
Submit before 16 November 2026, 11:45 PM — there is no correction window after that.
donts: Do not apply without an Honours degree in the relevant subject — a plain pass degree does not qualify.
Do not expect any correction window — the form is final once submitted.
Do not use an old photograph — it must be taken within 15 days.
Do not wait for the last hours — the portal closes at 11:45 PM on 16 November 2026.

Register and fill the online form for Laboratory Assistant-cum-Storekeeper

Pay the fee online (₹500, or ₹200 for SC/ST/PwD)
Review carefully — there is no correction after final submission
Submit before 16 November 2026, 11:45 PM and save the acknowledgement

extra_faq.q: What is the last date to apply for Odisha SSB Laboratory Assistant-cum-Storekeeper 2026?
extra_faq.a: 16 November 2026, up to 11:45 PM, online only on ssbodisha.ac.in. The application window opened on 12 October 2026 at 2:30 PM.

extra_faq.q: Is there an interview in this recruitment?
extra_faq.a: No. Selection is through a single written test only — 100 MCQs, 150 marks, 2 hours, +1.5 for a correct answer and −0.5 for a wrong one, with qualifying marks of 40% (UR) or 30% (reserved categories).

extra_faq.q: What is the fee for Odisha SSB Laboratory Assistant-cum-Storekeeper?
extra_faq.a: ₹500 for most candidates and ₹200 for SC/ST/PwD candidates, paid online. The fee is non-refundable.

en.name: AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026
en.tagline: 55 faculty posts at AIIMS Bathinda — Professor 17, Additional Professor 4, Associate Professor 16, Assistant Professor 18 — online Google Form till 30 November 2026, hard copy by 3 December.
en.qual: PG medical qualification + experience per Annexure-A (MCI/NMC norms)
fees: Application fee: ₹2,360 for General/OBC/EWS (including 18% GST) and ₹1,180 for SC/ST candidates, paid online. PwBD candidates pay nothing. The fee is non-refundable.
Pay the fee with the online form by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM.
specs: Attach two passport-size photographs with the hard-copy application.
The notice prints no pixel or KB sizes for the photographs — use recent passport-size photos as the institute asks.
eligibility: 55 Group-A faculty vacancies (provisional) — Professor 17, Additional Professor 4, Associate Professor 16, Assistant Professor 18. Direct recruitment.

Qualification and experience are as per Annexure-A on the institute website, following MCI/NMC norms for the post — a PG medical qualification with the required teaching and research experience, counted as on 30 November 2026. Indian nationals and OCI cardholders can apply.

Age as on 30 November 2026: Professor and Additional Professor — maximum 58 years; Associate Professor and Assistant Professor — maximum 50 years. Relaxation: SC/ST +5, OBC +3, government servants +5, PwBD and ex-servicemen as per DoPT rules.

Selection: scrutiny and shortlisting (a written exam may be held if there are many applicants), then a personal interview in person at Bathinda — there is no online interview and no TA/DA. Probation is 2 years; NPS applies.

Apply in two steps: fill the online Google Form by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM, AND send the hard copy of the application so it reaches the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bathinda–151001 by 3 December 2026, 5:00 PM.
dos: Read Annexure-A on aiimsbathinda.edu.in for the exact qualification and experience of your post before applying.
Submit the online Google Form by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM.
Send the hard copy so it reaches the Recruitment Cell by 3 December 2026, 5:00 PM — the online form alone is not enough.
Attach two passport-size photographs with the hard copy.
Keep the fee receipt and the form's acknowledgement safe.
donts: Do not skip the hard copy — applications without it are not considered.
Do not apply for a post whose Annexure-A experience you do not meet.
Do not expect an online interview — the interview is in person at Bathinda.
Do not wait for the last day — the hard copy must reach by 3 December 2026.

Age proof (max 58 for Professor/Addl. Professor; 50 for Associate/Assistant Professor)

Hard copy of the application with all enclosures

Print the filled form and attach two passport-size photographs and all enclosures
Send the hard copy by post or hand so it reaches the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bathinda–151001 by 3 December 2026, 5:00 PM
Wait for the shortlist — the interview is in person at Bathinda

extra_faq.a: The online Google Form closes on 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM. The hard copy of the application must reach the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bathinda, by 3 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.

extra_faq.q: How many faculty posts are there in AIIMS Bathinda 2026?
extra_faq.a: 55 posts — Professor 17, Additional Professor 4, Associate Professor 16 and Assistant Professor 18, all Group-A direct recruitment (provisional).

extra_faq.a: A written exam may be held only if there are many applicants. The main selection is scrutiny and shortlisting followed by a personal interview in person at Bathinda.

en.tagline: 16 engineering posts in Gujarat — Executive Engineer (Civil/Mechanical), Deputy Executive Engineer and Assistant Engineer — no experience needed, prelims on 17 January 2027, last date 20 November 2026.
en.qual: B.E./B.Tech in Civil / Mechanical / Marine / Electrical (post-wise)
fees: Application fee: ₹100 plus charges for unreserved candidates. Gujarat reserved-category, EWS, ex-servicemen and PwD candidates pay nothing.
Pay online by 20 November 2026, 11:59 PM; a post-office challan can be paid by 21 November 2026.
specs: Upload the photo and signature on the OJAS portal in the format the portal asks for.
The sources read do not print fixed KB or pixel sizes for the photo and signature — follow the OJAS portal's instructions at upload time.
eligibility: 16 posts across six advertisements (60–65/2026-27) — Executive Engineer (Civil), Class-1, Gujarat Maritime Board 1; Executive Engineer (Mechanical), Class-1, GMB 1; Deputy Executive Engineer (Civil), Class-2, Sports Authority of Gujarat 4; Assistant Engineer (Civil), Class-2 4; Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Class-2 4; Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Class-2, GMB 2.

Education: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (EE-Civil, Deputy EE, AE-Civil), Mechanical or Marine Engineering (EE-Mechanical), or Electrical Engineering (AE-Electrical). No experience is required for any of these posts.
Age: not more than 35 years as on 20 November 2026. Relaxation: women +5 years; Gujarat SC/ST/SEBC/EWS +5 years; women of those categories +10 years; PwD +10 years — all capped at 45 years.

Selection: a preliminary test (300 marks, objective) — the General Studies paper is on 17 January 2027, 11 AM–12 noon; the subject paper date will be announced — followed by an interview of 100 marks. Final merit is 50:50 prelims and interview.
Apply online on gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in from 6 November to 20 November 2026, 11:59 PM.
dos: Check the post-wise engineering branch before applying — Civil, Mechanical/Marine and Electrical posts need different degrees.
Apply on the OJAS portal (gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in), not on the GPSC main site.
Pay the ₹100 fee online by 20 November 2026 (challan by 21 November).
Note the General Studies paper date — 17 January 2027, 11 AM–12 noon.
Save the application number and fee receipt after submitting.
donts: Do not apply for a post whose engineering branch does not match your degree.
Do not assume experience is needed — none of these posts asks for it.
Do not wait for the last day — the portal closes at 11:59 PM on 20 November 2026.
Do not miss the challan date if you pay by post office — 21 November 2026.
checklist: B.E./B.Tech degree certificate (Civil / Mechanical / Marine / Electrical)
Age proof (not more than 35 on 20 Nov 2026, before relaxation)
Gujarat caste / EWS / PwD certificate (if claiming fee exemption or relaxation)
Photo and signature in the OJAS portal's format
Online fee payment (₹100, unless exempt)
Application number and fee receipt
steps: Open gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in and read Advertisements 60–65/2026-27
Register on OJAS and choose the post matching your engineering branch
Fill the online form and upload the photo and signature
Pay the fee online (₹100, unless exempt)
Submit before 20 November 2026, 11:59 PM and save the acknowledgement
Prepare for the General Studies paper on 17 January 2027

extra_faq.q: What is the last date to apply for GPSC Executive Engineer / Assistant Engineer 2026?
extra_faq.a: 20 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM, online only on gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in. The application window opened on 6 November 2026.

extra_faq.q: Is experience required for GPSC EE / AE posts?
extra_faq.a: No. None of the 16 posts asks for experience — a B.E./B.Tech in the relevant branch (Civil, Mechanical/Marine or Electrical) is enough.

extra_faq.q: What is the selection process for GPSC engineers?
extra_faq.a: A preliminary test of 300 marks (objective) — General Studies paper on 17 January 2027, 11 AM–12 noon, subject paper date to be announced — followed by an interview of 100 marks. Final merit is 50:50 prelims and interview.

fees: No application fee is specified in the notice — applying is free.
specs: Upload a scanned passport-size colour photograph and signature in the format the SAI jobs portal asks for.

eligibility: 17 contractual High Performance Coach posts across SAI centres in India. The engagement is for 1 year, or till age 64, whichever is earlier (maximum tenure till 65).

Qualification (any one): a Diploma in coaching from SAI NS NIS Patiala or an equivalent institute; OR participation in the Olympics, Paralympics, Asian Games or World Championship with a certificate course in coaching; OR a Dronacharya Awardee.
AND: you must hold an analogous post, OR have 5 years of regular service in Pay Level-12 (₹78,800–2,09,200) under the Central or State Government or a UT. 5 years of coaching experience is desirable.
Age: maximum 64 years as on the opening date, 30 October 2026. This is effectively a post for retired or senior serving government coaches — not a freshers' exam.
Selection: shortlisting on relevant experience and job description, followed by an interview. There is no written exam.
Pay: Level-13, ₹1,23,100–2,15,900 (last pay drawn minus pension). Apply online on sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs from 30 October to 1 December 2026.

Check the age limit — maximum 64 years as on 30 October 2026.
Submit before 1 December 2026.
Save the application number after submitting.
donts: Do not apply as a fresher — this post needs senior coaching credentials and Level-12 government service.
Do not treat this as a permanent SAI job — it is a 1-year contract.
Do not expect a written exam — selection is shortlisting plus interview.
Do not wait for the last day — the portal closes on 1 December 2026.

extra_faq.q: Can freshers apply for SAI High Performance Coach?

hi.tagline: भारतीय खेल प्राधिकरण में 17 हाई परफॉर्मेंस कोच पद — contractual, NIS डिप्लोमा या अंतरराष्ट्रीय भागीदारी वाले सीनियर कोचों के लिए — सिर्फ़ साक्षात्कार, कोई शुल्क नहीं, अंतिम तिथि 1 दिसंबर 2026।
hi.qual: SAI NS NIS पटियाला से कोचिंग में डिप्लोमा (या समकक्ष) / अंतरराष्ट्रीय भागीदारी + कोचिंग प्रमाणपत्र / द्रोणाचार्य पुरस्कार + लेवल-12 सेवा
fees: Notice में कोई आवेदन शुल्क नहीं दिया गया है — आवेदन मुफ़्त है।
specs: SAI jobs portal के बताए format में scan की हुई पासपोर्ट साइज़ रंगीन फोटो और हस्ताक्षर upload करें।
पढ़े गए स्रोतों में फोटो और हस्ताक्षर का कोई निश्चित KB या pixel size नहीं छपा है — upload के समय portal के निर्देश देखो।
eligibility: भारत भर के SAI केंद्रों में 17 contractual हाई परफॉर्मेंस कोच पद। Engagement 1 साल के लिए है, या 64 साल की उम्र तक, जो पहले हो (अधिकतम tenure 65 साल तक)।

योग्यता (कोई एक): SAI NS NIS पटियाला या समकक्ष संस्थान से कोचिंग में डिप्लोमा; या ओलंपिक, पैरालंपिक, एशियाई खेल या विश्व चैंपियनशिप में भागीदारी साथ में कोचिंग में प्रमाणपत्र कोर्स; या द्रोणाचार्य पुरस्कार विजेता।
और: तुम्हें समकक्ष पद पर होना चाहिए, या केंद्र/राज्य सरकार या केंद्र शासित प्रदेश के तहत पे लेवल-12 (₹78,800–2,09,200) में 5 साल की नियमित सेवा होनी चाहिए। 5 साल का कोचिंग अनुभव वांछनीय है।
उम्र: खुलने की तारीख 30 अक्टूबर 2026 को अधिकतम 64 वर्ष। यह असल में retired या सीनियर सेवारत सरकारी कोचों के लिए पद है — freshers की परीक्षा नहीं।
चयन: संबंधित अनुभव और job description पर शॉर्टलिस्टिंग, फिर साक्षात्कार। कोई लिखित परीक्षा नहीं है।
वेतन: लेवल-13, ₹1,23,100–₹2,15,900 (अंतिम वेतन minus pension)। आवेदन sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs पर ऑनलाइन, 30 अक्टूबर से 1 दिसंबर 2026 तक।
dos: सिर्फ़ तभी आवेदन करो जब तुम्हारे पास notice में माँगा गया कोचिंग डिप्लोमा या अंतरराष्ट्रीय भागीदारी हो, साथ में लेवल-12 सेवा।
कोचिंग डिप्लोमा, भागीदारी प्रमाणपत्र और सेवा रिकॉर्ड साक्षात्कार के लिए तैयार रखो।
उम्र-सीमा जाँचो — 30 अक्टूबर 2026 को अधिकतम 64 वर्ष।
1 दिसंबर 2026 से पहले submit करो।
Submit के बाद आवेदन संख्या संभालकर रखो।
donts: Fresher के रूप में आवेदन मत करो — इस पद के लिए सीनियर कोचिंग योग्यता और लेवल-12 सरकारी सेवा चाहिए।
इसे SAI की permanent नौकरी मत समझो — यह 1 साल का contract है।
लिखित परीक्षा की उम्मीद मत करो — चयन शॉर्टलिस्टिंग और साक्षात्कार से होगा।
आखिरी दिन का इंतज़ार मत करो — portal 1 दिसंबर 2026 को बंद हो जाएगा।

en.name: Bank of Baroda Senior IT Posts — Dy CTO, Head AI 2026
en.tagline: 4 senior IT posts at Bank of Baroda — SVP Deputy CTO, VP Head AI, DVP Deputy Head Cloud CoE and DVP Deputy Head Platform Engineering — fixed-term contract, no fee, last date 17 November 2026.
en.qual: B.E./B.Tech (CS/IT/relevant) or MCA + 12–15 years of relevant experience
fees: No application fee — applying is free for all candidates.
specs: Photo: 4.5×3.5 cm, 200×230 px (preferred), JPG, 20–50 KB, recent passport-style colour photo on a light or white background. Signature: black ink on white paper, 140×60 px, 10–20 KB, NOT in capital letters.
Other documents: a single PDF each, A4 size, maximum 500 KB.
eligibility: 4 posts, all UR, based in Mumbai — SVP Deputy Chief Technology Officer 1, VP Head AI 1, DVP Deputy Head Cloud Centre of Excellence 1, DVP Deputy Head Platform Engineering 1.
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a relevant branch, or MCA. Detailed per-post criteria sit in the role annexures linked with the advertisement.

Experience: Deputy CTO — at least 15 years of relevant experience. Head AI — at least 12 years in technology/IT, including 6 years of post-qualification experience in AI, NLP or content analysis. Maximum-age figures per post are not stated in the main advertisement text.
Cut-off date: 1 October 2026. Relaxation: SC/ST +5 years, OBC +3 years, PwBD +10/13/15 years.

Selection: application scrutiny, then a psychometric test and/or personal interview, plus compensation negotiation. The personal interview is qualifying — 60% for General/EWS, 55% for reserved categories.
Apply online on bankofbaroda.bank.in (Careers → Current Opportunities) from 28 October to 17 November 2026. No change is possible after submitting.
dos: Read the role annexures for your post before applying — the detailed criteria are there, not in the main advertisement.
Apply only if your experience matches — Deputy CTO needs 15 years, Head AI needs 12 years.
Upload the photo (20–50 KB) and signature (10–20 KB, not in capitals) in the exact sizes.
Submit before 17 November 2026 — no change is possible after submitting.
Save the application number after submitting.
donts: Do not treat these as permanent bank posts — they are fixed-term contracts of 3 years, extendable to a maximum of 5 years or age 60.
Do not apply without the required years of relevant experience.
Do not sign in capital letters — the signature must not be in capitals.
Do not expect a correction window — there is none.

extra_faq.a: No. They are fixed-term contract posts — an initial term of 3 years, extendable 1 year at a time up to a maximum of 5 years or age 60.

छूट: SC/ST +5 वर्ष, OBC-NCL +3 वर्ष, PwBD +10/13/15 वर्ष।

चयन: CBT (200 अंक, 120 मिनट, गलत उत्तर पर −0.25) साथ में ऑफिसरों के लिए साक्षात्कार (60:40 CBT:साक्षात्कार) या अन्य पदों के लिए स्किल टेस्ट (qualifying)। JPA: 100 अंकों का Part A साथ में stenography test। परीक्षा की तारीख बाद में; केंद्रों में दिल्ली, चंडीगढ़ और कोलकाता शामिल हैं।

en.tagline: 32 Executive posts at Oil India — Senior Officer (Mechanical/Petroleum), Senior Accounts Officer, Research Scientist, Hindi Officer and more — CBT + interview, last date 14 November 2026 (11 AM).
fees: Application fee: ₹500 plus taxes for General/OBC-NCL candidates. SC/ST/PwBD/EWS/ex-servicemen pay nothing. The fee is non-refundable.
Pay the fee by 14 November 2026, 11:00 AM.
specs: Photo: 100–200 KB, JPG/JPEG (as per the notice as reported).

eligibility: 32 posts — Senior Officer (Mechanical) 14, Senior Accounts Officer / Senior Internal Auditor 6, Superintending Research Scientist 5, Senior Officer (Petroleum) 4, Hindi Officer 2, Confidential Secretary 1.

Research Scientist: PhD in Chemistry, Geology or Petroleum Engineering, plus a relevant Master's with 60% and 4 years of experience; UR age up to 37. Senior Officer (Mechanical): 4-year B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with 65%; UR age up to 27.

Senior Officer (Petroleum): a 2-year Master's in Petroleum Engineering/Technology with 60% plus an engineering degree. Accounts: Associate Membership of ICAI or ICMAI. Hindi Officer: PG in Hindi plus 3 years of experience. Confidential Secretary: graduation plus a 1- or 2-year secretarial diploma plus 2 years of experience (PwBD backlog post).
Grade B posts (except Accounts) carry a 3-year service bond; probation is 1 year. All eligibility is counted as on 14 November 2026.

Selection: a CBT of 100 marks in 90 minutes (qualifying 50 for UR/OBC/EWS, 40 for SC/ST/PwBD), then a Personal Interview of 15 marks — final merit is CBT × 0.85 + interview — for Grade B/C posts. For Grade A posts: CBT plus a proficiency/skill test (qualifying; merit on the CBT). The CBT is tentatively on 28 December 2026.
Apply online through oil-india.com (apply via the DigiALM portal) from 15 October 2026 (4:00 PM) to 14 November 2026, 11:00 AM. No correction window is mentioned.

Do not ignore the 3-year service bond on Grade B posts.

eligibility: 20 posts — Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) 15 and Office Attendant 5, in the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Secretariat.
JSA: Intermediate (10+2) in any subject. Office Attendant: Matric (10th) pass. The qualification must be held by 6 December 2026.

Age: minimum 18 years as on 1 August 2026; maximum 37 years for UR men, 40 for UR women and BC/EBC candidates, 42 for SC/ST. Extra relaxation: Bihar government servants +5 years, PwD +10 years, ex-servicemen +3 years plus service, with an overall cap of 57 years. Reservation applies only to Bihar domiciles.

Selection — JSA: an OMR preliminary exam (100 MCQs, 400 marks, +4 for a correct answer and −1 for a wrong one, 2 hours; qualifying 40% General, 36.5% BC, 34% EBC, 32% SC/ST/women/PwD), followed by Hindi and English typing tests at 30 words per minute each (Hindi in Kruti Dev font, 10 minutes, 1.5% error allowance). There is no interview. Office Attendant: an interview of 100 marks (a preliminary OMR exam is held only if applicants exceed 40,000).
Apply online on blasrecruit.in from 7 November 2026 (11:00 AM) to 6 December 2026. There is NO correction facility — the submission is final.
dos: Check the fee for your category before paying — Bihar-domicile SC/ST, PwD and women pay less, but nobody is fully exempt.
For JSA, practise Hindi typing in Kruti Dev font at 30 words per minute — it is part of selection.
Review the form carefully before the final submit — there is NO correction window.
Keep your Bihar domicile certificate ready if you claim reservation.
Submit before 6 December 2026.
donts: Do not expect any correction after submitting — the advertisement explicitly gives no correction facility.
Do not claim reservation without Bihar domicile — reservation is only for Bihar domiciles.
Do not apply for JSA without Intermediate (10+2).
Do not wait for the last day — the portal closes on 6 December 2026.

Fill the online form and upload the photo and signature
Pay the fee online for your category
Review carefully — there is NO correction after submitting
Submit before 6 December 2026 and save the acknowledgement

चयन — JSA: OMR प्रारंभिक परीक्षा (100 MCQ, 400 अंक, सही उत्तर पर +4 और गलत पर −1, 2 घंटे; qualifying General 40%, BC 36.5%, EBC 34%, SC/ST/महिला/PwD 32%), फिर हिंदी और अंग्रेज़ी टाइपिंग टेस्ट 30 शब्द प्रति मिनट प्रत्येक (हिंदी Kruti Dev font में, 10 मिनट, 1.5% त्रुटि छूट)। कोई साक्षात्कार नहीं है। ऑफिस अटेंडेंट: 100 अंकों का साक्षात्कार (प्रारंभिक OMR परीक्षा सिर्फ़ तब होगी जब आवेदक 40,000 से ज़्यादा हुए)।
आवेदन blasrecruit.in पर ऑनलाइन, 7 नवंबर 2026 (सुबह 11:00) से 6 दिसंबर 2026 तक। कोई correction सुविधा नहीं है — submit अंतिम होता है।

JSA के लिए Kruti Dev font में हिंदी टाइपिंग 30 शब्द प्रति मिनट की practice करो — यह चयन का हिस्सा है।
Final submit से पहले फॉर्म ध्यान से review करो — कोई correction window नहीं है।
आरक्षण का दावा हो तो बिहार domicile प्रमाणपत्र तैयार रखो।
6 दिसंबर 2026 से पहले submit करो।

आखिरी दिन का इंतज़ार मत करो — portal 6 दिसंबर 2026 को बंद हो जाएगा।

en.name: AFCAT 01/2027 — Air Force Common Admission Test
en.tagline: 284 officer posts in the Indian Air Force — Flying Branch 36, Ground Duty (Technical & Non-Technical) and NCC Special Entry — online test on 31 January 2027, last date 11 December 2026.
en.qual: 10+2 with Physics and Maths + graduation / B.E./B.Tech (branch-wise; see eligibility)
fees: AFCAT entry: ₹550 + 18% GST, paid online. NCC Special Entry and GATE Score Entry candidates pay no fee.
Pay the fee online on the AFCAT portal before 11 December 2026, 11:30 PM.
specs: Photo: JPG, 100–200 KB. Signature: JPG, 80–150 KB. Left-thumb impression: JPG, 50–100 KB.
Keep your Aadhaar card ready — Aadhaar details are mandatory in the application. Upload the photo, signature and thumb impression only in the sizes the portal asks for.
eligibility: 284 vacancies — Flying Branch 36; Ground Duty (Technical): Aeronautical Engineer (Electronics) 88 and (Mechanical) 36; Ground Duty (Non-Technical): Weapon Systems 30, Administration 53, Logistics 11, Accounts 8, Education 4, Meteorology 2; GATE Score Entry: AE(L) 11 and AE(M) 5. Men Permanent Commission 20, Women PC 11, Men Short Service Commission 177, Women SSC 76. NCC Special Entry is 10% of the AFCAT SSC seats, within this total.

Age reckoned on 1 January 2028 — Flying Branch: 20–24 years (born 2 January 2004 to 1 January 2008; CPL holders up to 26). All Ground Duty branches: 20–26 years (born 2 January 2002 to 1 January 2008).

Qualification — Flying: 10+2 with Physics and Maths plus any 3-year graduation or B.E./B.Tech. AE(L)/(M): B.E./B.Tech in the listed disciplines. Administration and Logistics: any graduation. Accounts: B.Com, BBA (Finance), CA, CMA, CS or CFA. Education: a post-graduation. Meteorology: B.Sc with Physics and Maths or listed engineering degrees.

Selection: online test (100 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours, +3 for a correct answer and −1 for a wrong one, English only) on 31 January 2027, 10:00 AM–12 noon, then AFSB interview at Dehradun, Mysuru, Gandhinagar, Varanasi or Guwahati, then CPSS for Flying Branch only, then a medical examination. Training starts in the first week of January 2028 (74 weeks for Flying/GD-Technical, 50 weeks for GD Non-Technical).

Pay: Level-10, ₹56,100–1,77,500, plus Military Service Pay ₹15,500 per month. Candidates must be unmarried at the start of the course. Apply online only from 12 November 2026, 11:00 AM to 11 December 2026, 11:30 PM.
dos: Check your branch's exact qualification in the 66-page notification before applying.
Keep your Aadhaar details ready — they are mandatory.
Upload the photo (100–200 KB), signature (80–150 KB) and thumb impression (50–100 KB) in the exact sizes.
Download the admit card from 27 January 2027, 11:00 AM.
Note the exam date — 31 January 2027, 10:00 AM–12 noon, English only.
donts: Do not apply for a branch whose qualification you do not meet — branch-wise degrees are strictly checked.
Do not use an old or wrong-size photo — the portal rejects sizes outside 100–200 KB.
Do not miss the 11 December 2026, 11:30 PM deadline — the portal closes then.
Do not pay the fee for NCC Special Entry or GATE Score Entry — there is no fee for those entries.
checklist: 10+2 certificate with Physics and Maths

Aadhaar card

CPL licence (Flying Branch, if claiming age relaxation to 26)
steps: Open the AFCAT portal and read Advertisement 01/2027 (66-page notification)
Register with your Aadhaar details and choose your entry and branch
Fill the online form and upload the photo, signature and thumb impression
Pay the fee online (₹550 + GST; no fee for NCC Special / GATE entry)
Submit before 11 December 2026, 11:30 PM and save the acknowledgement
Download the admit card from 27 January 2027 and appear for the online test on 31 January 2027

extra_faq.q: What is the last date to apply for AFCAT 01/2027?
extra_faq.a: 11 December 2026, up to 11:30 PM, online only. Registration opens on 12 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

extra_faq.q: How many posts are there in AFCAT 01/2027?
extra_faq.a: 284 posts — Flying Branch 36, Ground Duty (Technical) 124, Ground Duty (Non-Technical) 108, and GATE Score Entry 16. NCC Special Entry is 10% of the AFCAT SSC seats, within this total.

extra_faq.q: What is the exam date and pattern for AFCAT 01/2027?
extra_faq.a: The online test is on 31 January 2027, 10:00 AM–12 noon — 100 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours, +3 for a correct answer and −1 for a wrong one, in English only. Admit cards are available from 27 January 2027, 11:00 AM.

hi.tagline: भारतीय वायु सेना में 284 अधिकारी पद — फ्लाइंग ब्रांच 36, ग्राउंड ड्यूटी (तकनीकी और गैर-तकनीकी) और NCC स्पेशल एंट्री — ऑनलाइन परीक्षा 31 जनवरी 2027, अंतिम तिथि 11 दिसंबर 2026।
hi.qual: 10+2 में भौतिकी और गणित + स्नातक / B.E./B.Tech (शाखा के अनुसार; पात्रता देखें)
fees: AFCAT एंट्री: ₹550 + 18% GST, ऑनलाइन भुगतान। NCC स्पेशल एंट्री और GATE स्कोर एंट्री के उम्मीदवारों को कोई शुल्क नहीं देना है।
शुल्क 11 दिसंबर 2026, रात 11:30 से पहले AFCAT portal पर ऑनलाइन भरें।
specs: फोटो: JPG, 100–200 KB। हस्ताक्षर: JPG, 80–150 KB। बाएँ अँगूठे का निशान: JPG, 50–100 KB।
आधार कार्ड तैयार रखो — आवेदन में आधार विवरण अनिवार्य है। फोटो, हस्ताक्षर और अँगूठे का निशान सिर्फ़ portal के बताए size में upload करो।
eligibility: 284 रिक्तियाँ — फ्लाइंग ब्रांच 36; ग्राउंड ड्यूटी (तकनीकी): एयरोनॉटिकल इंजीनियर (इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स) 88 और (मैकेनिकल) 36; ग्राउंड ड्यूटी (गैर-तकनीकी): वेपन सिस्टम 30, प्रशासन 53, लॉजिस्टिक्स 11, लेखा 8, शिक्षा 4, मौसम विज्ञान 2; GATE स्कोर एंट्री: AE(L) 11 और AE(M) 5। पुरुष स्थायी कमीशन 20, महिला PC 11, पुरुष अल्प सेवा कमीशन 177, महिला SSC 76। NCC स्पेशल एंट्री AFCAT SSC सीटों का 10% है, इसी कुल में।
उम्र 1 जनवरी 2028 को गिनी जाएगी — फ्लाइंग ब्रांच: 20–24 वर्ष (जन्म 2 जनवरी 2004 से 1 जनवरी 2008; CPL धारक 26 तक)। सभी ग्राउंड ड्यूटी शाखाएँ: 20–26 वर्ष (जन्म 2 जनवरी 2002 से 1 जनवरी 2008)।

योग्यता — फ्लाइंग: भौतिकी और गणित के साथ 10+2, साथ में कोई 3-साल की स्नातक डिग्री या B.E./B.Tech। AE(L)/(M): सूचीबद्ध विषयों में B.E./B.Tech। प्रशासन और लॉजिस्टिक्स: कोई भी स्नातक डिग्री। लेखा: B.Com, BBA (फाइनेंस), CA, CMA, CS या CFA। शिक्षा: स्नातकोत्तर। मौसम विज्ञान: भौतिकी और गणित के साथ B.Sc या सूचीबद्ध इंजीनियरिंग डिग्री।

चयन: ऑनलाइन परीक्षा (100 प्रश्न, 300 अंक, 2 घंटे, सही उत्तर पर +3 और गलत पर −1, सिर्फ़ अंग्रेज़ी) 31 जनवरी 2027, सुबह 10:00–12:00, फिर देहरादून, मैसूरु, गांधीनगर, वाराणसी या गुवाहाटी में AFSB साक्षात्कार, फिर सिर्फ़ फ्लाइंग ब्रांच के लिए CPSS, फिर मेडिकल जाँच। प्रशिक्षण जनवरी 2028 के पहले हफ़्ते से शुरू (फ्लाइंग/GD-तकनीकी 74 हफ़्ते, GD-गैर-तकनीकी 50 हफ़्ते)।

वेतन: लेवल-10, ₹56,100–1,77,500, साथ में सैन्य सेवा वेतन ₹15,500 प्रति माह। कोर्स शुरू होने पर उम्मीदवार अविवाहित होना चाहिए। आवेदन सिर्फ़ ऑनलाइन, 12 नवंबर 2026, सुबह 11:00 से 11 दिसंबर 2026, रात 11:30 तक।
dos: आवेदन से पहले 66-पेज की अधिसूचना में अपनी शाखा की सटीक योग्यता जाँचो।
आधार विवरण तैयार रखो — यह अनिवार्य है।
फोटो (100–200 KB), हस्ताक्षर (80–150 KB) और अँगूठे का निशान (50–100 KB) सटीक size में upload करो।
27 जनवरी 2027, सुबह 11:00 से admit card डाउनलोड करो।
परीक्षा की तारीख नोट करो — 31 जनवरी 2027, सुबह 10:00–12:00, सिर्फ़ अंग्रेज़ी।
donts: जिस शाखा की योग्यता पूरी नहीं होती, उसके लिए आवेदन मत करो — शाखा-वार डिग्री सख्ती से जाँची जाती है।
पुरानी या गलत size की फोटो मत लगाओ — portal 100–200 KB से बाहर का size मंज़ूर नहीं करता।
11 दिसंबर 2026, रात 11:30 की deadline मत चूको — portal उसी समय बंद हो जाएगा।
NCC स्पेशल एंट्री या GATE स्कोर एंट्री का शुल्क मत भरो — उनमें कोई शुल्क नहीं है।

en.name: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant (T-3) & Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) 2026
en.tagline: 1,393 posts at ICAR institutes — Technical Assistant (T-3) 1,254 and Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) 139 — prelims in February 2027, last date 17 December 2026.
en.qual: Relevant Bachelor's degree (3-year engineering diploma only for Workshop Staff groups)
fees: Fee per post: ₹300 for UR, ₹150 for EWS/OBC. Applying for both posts: ₹600 (UR) / ₹300 (EWS/OBC). SC/ST/PwBD/women and ex-servicemen pay nothing. Pay through Bharatkosh and upload the receipt with the form.
Pay the fee before the final submission on 17 December 2026, 11:59 PM.
specs: Photo: JPG, maximum 200 KB, white background, face covering at least two-thirds of the frame, no spectacles. Signature: JPG, maximum 100 KB, in black or blue ink.
Upload the Bharatkosh fee receipt with the application — the form is incomplete without it.
eligibility: 1,393 vacancies — Technical Assistant (T-3) 1,254 and Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) 139, in ICAR institutes across India. The notification (F. No. 2(2)/2025-Exam) is dated 11 November 2026.

Education: a relevant Bachelor's degree for the functional group you choose. A 3-year engineering diploma is accepted only for Workshop Staff groups. Choose only ONE functional group/subgroup — applying for more than one group is not allowed.
Age: 21–30 years as on 17 December 2026, with relaxation as per Government of India rules.

Selection: Prelims (100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour, −0.25 per wrong answer; qualifying 30% UR, 25% EWS/OBC, 20% SC/ST/PwBD) then Mains (100 questions, 300 marks, 2 hours, −1 per wrong answer, same qualifying percentages). There is no interview. Prelims are tentatively in February 2027.
Apply online only on asrb.gov.in from 18 November to 17 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Correction window: 18–20 December 2026.
dos: Choose only ONE functional group/subgroup — more than one group is not allowed.
Check the relevant Bachelor's degree for your group in the notification before applying.
Pay through Bharatkosh and upload the receipt with the form.
Upload a white-background photo (max 200 KB, face at least two-thirds of the frame, no spectacles).
Use the correction window (18–20 December 2026) if you made a mistake — it is only 3 days.

Do not apply with a 3-year engineering diploma for a non-Workshop group — it is accepted only for Workshop Staff groups.
Do not forget the Bharatkosh receipt — the form is incomplete without it.
Do not miss the 17 December 2026, 11:59 PM deadline.

extra_faq.a: 1,393 posts — Technical Assistant (T-3) 1,254 and Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) 139, in ICAR institutes across India.

hi.name: ASRB ICAR टेक्निकल असिस्टेंट (T-3) और सीनियर टेक्निकल असिस्टेंट (T-4) 2026

hi.qual: संबंधित स्नातक डिग्री (3-साल का इंजीनियरिंग डिप्लोमा सिर्फ़ वर्कशॉप स्टाफ समूहों के लिए)
fees: प्रति पद शुल्क: UR के लिए ₹300, EWS/OBC के लिए ₹150। दोनों पदों के लिए: ₹600 (UR) / ₹300 (EWS/OBC)। SC/ST/PwBD/महिला और भूतपूर्व सैनिक कुछ नहीं भरते। Bharatkosh से भुगतान करो और रसीद फॉर्म के साथ upload करो।
शुल्क 17 दिसंबर 2026, रात 11:59 तक final submission से पहले भरो।

Bharatkosh शुल्क रसीद आवेदन के साथ upload करो — उसके बिना फॉर्म अधूरा है।
eligibility: 1,393 रिक्तियाँ — टेक्निकल असिस्टेंट (T-3) 1,254 और सीनियर टेक्निकल असिस्टेंट (T-4) 139, पूरे भारत के ICAR संस्थानों में। अधिसूचना (F. No. 2(2)/2025-Exam) 11 नवंबर 2026 की है।

उम्र: 17 दिसंबर 2026 को 21–30 वर्ष, भारत सरकार के नियमों के अनुसार छूट।

Bharatkosh रसीद मत भूलो — उसके बिना फॉर्म अधूरा है।

fees: Total ₹370 (₹250 processing fee + ₹120 examination fee) for most candidates. SC/ST/BC, ex-servicemen, AP White Card holders and unemployed youth of Andhra Pradesh pay only the ₹250 processing fee. Other-state candidates pay the full ₹370. The examination-fee component is ₹120 for the AMVI notification (No. 36/2026); check your own post's detailed notification — some APPSC notifications in this set carry an ₹80 examination fee instead.
Pay the fee online on psc.ap.gov.in before 26 November 2026, 11:59 PM.

Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector: a degree in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering, or a diploma in Automobile Engineering, plus a motor driving licence with 3 years of experience and a Heavy Transport vehicle endorsement.
Other posts: a relevant degree or diploma as per the post's detailed notification — check your post's notification before applying.

Apply online only on portal-psc.ap.gov.in/LoginApplication from 6 to 26 November 2026, after completing OTPR on psc.ap.gov.in.
dos: Complete your OTPR on psc.ap.gov.in before applying — the form needs it.

fees: कुल ₹370 (₹250 प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क + ₹120 परीक्षा शुल्क) अधिकतर उम्मीदवारों के लिए। आंध्र प्रदेश के SC/ST/BC, भूतपूर्व सैनिक, AP व्हाइट कार्ड धारक और बेरोज़गार युवा सिर्फ़ ₹250 प्रोसेसिंग शुल्क भरते हैं। अन्य राज्यों के उम्मीदवार पूरा ₹370 भरते हैं। परीक्षा शुल्क का हिस्सा AMVI अधिसूचना (सं. 36/2026) के लिए ₹120 है; अपने पद की विस्तृत अधिसूचना जाँचो — इस सेट की कुछ APPSC अधिसूचनाओं में परीक्षा शुल्क ₹80 है।
शुल्क 26 नवंबर 2026, रात 11:59 से पहले psc.ap.gov.in पर ऑनलाइन भरें।
specs: APPSC portal के बताए format में फोटो और हस्ताक्षर upload करो।

पढ़े गए स्रोतों में फोटो और हस्ताक्षर का कोई निश्चित KB या pixel size नहीं छपा है — upload के समय portal के निर्देश देखो। आवेदन से पहले psc.ap.gov.in पर अपना One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) पूरा करो।
eligibility: छह अधिसूचनाओं (31–36/2026) में 106 रिक्तियाँ — असिस्टेंट मोटर व्हीकल इंस्पेक्टर 50, असिस्टेंट डायरेक्टर (माइंस) 1, असिस्टेंट केमिकल एग्ज़ामिनर 9, रॉयल्टी इंस्पेक्टर 9, टेक्निकल असिस्टेंट 36, लैब असिस्टेंट 1। संक्षिप्त अधिसूचनाएँ 13 अक्टूबर 2026 की हैं; विस्तृत अधिसूचनाएँ 6 नवंबर 2026 को आईं।

असिस्टेंट मोटर व्हीकल इंस्पेक्टर: मैकेनिकल या ऑटोमोबाइल इंजीनियरिंग में डिग्री, या ऑटोमोबाइल इंजीनियरिंग में डिप्लोमा, साथ में 3 साल के अनुभव वाला मोटर ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस और हेवी ट्रांसपोर्ट वाहन endorsement।
अन्य पद: पद की विस्तृत अधिसूचना के अनुसार संबंधित डिग्री या डिप्लोमा — आवेदन से पहले अपने पद की अधिसूचना जाँचो।
उम्र 1 जुलाई 2026 को: AMVI 21–36 वर्ष; अन्य पद 18–44 वर्ष, आंध्र प्रदेश सरकार के नियमों के अनुसार छूट।

चयन: कंप्यूटर आधारित भर्ती परीक्षा — पेपर-I सामान्य अध्ययन और मानसिक योग्यता (150 प्रश्न, 150 अंक, 150 मिनट) और पेपर-II विषय पर (150 प्रश्न, 300 या 150 अंक), गलत उत्तर पर −1/3 — फिर कंप्यूटर प्रवीणता परीक्षा।
आवेदन सिर्फ़ portal-psc.ap.gov.in/LoginApplication पर ऑनलाइन, 6 से 26 नवंबर 2026 तक, psc.ap.gov.in पर OTPR पूरा करने के बाद।
dos: आवेदन से पहले psc.ap.gov.in पर OTPR पूरा करो — फॉर्म के लिए यह ज़रूरी है।
अपने पद की विस्तृत अधिसूचना में उसकी सटीक योग्यता और परीक्षा शुल्क (₹80 या ₹120) जाँचो।
AMVI के लिए ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस (3 साल का अनुभव + हेवी ट्रांसपोर्ट endorsement) तैयार रखो।
शुल्क ऑनलाइन भरो (₹370, या छूट वाली श्रेणियों के लिए ₹250)।
26 नवंबर 2026, रात 11:59 से पहले submit करो।
donts: ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस और हेवी ट्रांसपोर्ट endorsement के बिना AMVI के लिए आवेदन मत करो।
OTPR पूरा किए बिना आवेदन मत करो।
परीक्षा शुल्क हर पद के लिए एक-सा मत समझो — AMVI के लिए ₹120 है और कुछ अन्य अधिसूचनाओं के लिए ₹80।
26 नवंबर 2026 की deadline मत चूको।
